items.title: Quran 93:3-5
items.arabic: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ ﴿٣﴾ وَلَلۡأٓخِرَةُ خَيۡرࣱ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ ﴿٤﴾ وَلَسَوۡفَ يُعۡطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرۡضَىٰٓ ﴿٥﴾
items.urdu: (3) نہ تو تیرے رب نے تجھے چھوڑا ہے اور نہ وه بیزار ہو گیا ہے (4) یقیناً تیرے لئے انجام آغاز سے بہتر ہوگا (5) تجھے تیرا رب بہت جلد (انعام) دے گا اور تو راضی (وخوش) ہو جائے گا
items.english: (3) Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you] (4) And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life] (5) And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied
items.meaning:
Allah reassures the Prophet ﷺ after a pause in revelation: your Lord has not left you, nor is He displeased with you. What is coming is better than what has passed, and He will give until you are satisfied.

Contentment grows from trusting that Allah's giving is not finished.
items.reflection:
Your Lord has not left you.

What He has prepared is better than what you have now — rest in that.

items.title: Sahih al-Bukhari 6446
items.arabic: لَيْسَ الْغِنَى عَنْ كَثْرَةِ الْعَرَضِ، وَلَكِنَّ الْغِنَى غِنَى النَّفْسِ
items.urdu: تونگری یہ نہیں ہے کہ سامان زیادہ ہو، بلکہ امیری یہ ہے کہ دل غنی ہو
items.english: Wealth is not in having many possessions, but rather (true) wealth is feeling sufficiency in the soul.
items.meaning:
The Prophet ﷺ teaches that true wealth is not many possessions, but feeling sufficiency in the soul.

A person may own much and still feel empty; another may have little and feel rich because the heart is content.

Contentment is a gift that softens comparison and restless wanting.
items.reflection:
Ask Allah for richness of the heart, not only increase of things.

Sufficiency in the soul is a quiet form of wealth.

items.title: Sahih Muslim 1054
items.arabic: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَنْ أَسْلَمَ وَرُزِقَ كَفَافًا وَقَنَّعَهُ اللَّهُ بِمَا آتَاهُ
items.urdu: وہ انسان کا میاب و بامراد ہو گیا جو مسلمان ہو گیا اور اسے گزر بسر کے بقدر روزی ملی اور اللہ تعا لیٰ نے اسے جو دیا اس پر قناعت کی تو فیق بخشی
items.english: He Is successful who has accepted Islam, who has been provided with sufficient for his want and been made contented by Allah with what He has given him.
items.meaning:
The Prophet ﷺ describes success as accepting Islam, having enough for one’s needs, and being made content by Allah with what He has given.

Success here is not endless increase; it is faith joined with sufficiency and a satisfied heart.

Contentment is itself a form of divine favor.
items.reflection:
Look for success in faith and contentment, not only in accumulation.

Being pleased with Allah’s gift is part of thriving.

items.title: Sahih Muslim 2963a
items.arabic: إِذَا نَظَرَ أَحَدُكُمْ إِلَى مَنْ فُضِّلَ عَلَيْهِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْخَلْقِ فَلْيَنْظُرْ إِلَى مَنْ هُوَ أَسْفَلَ مِنْهُ مِمَّنْ فُضِّلَ عَلَيْهِ
items.urdu: جب تم میں سے کوئی شخص اس کی طرف دیکھے جسے مال اور جمال میں فضیلت حاصل ہے تو اس کو بھی دیکھے جو اس سے کمتر ہے ، جس پر ( خود ) اسے فضیلت حاصل ہے
items.english: When one of you looks at one who stands at a higher level than you in regard to wealth and physical structure he should also see one who stands at a lower level than you in regard to these things (in which he stands) at a higher level (as compared to him).
items.meaning:
The Prophet ﷺ gives a simple habit for a content heart: when you notice someone who has more, also notice someone who has less.

Comparing only upward breeds restlessness; looking at the whole picture brings gratitude.
items.reflection:
Look at what you have been given before you look at what others have.

The blessing you overlook today is someone else's prayer.

items.title: Quran 39:17-18
items.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱجۡتَنَبُواْ ٱلطَّٰغُوتَ أَن يَعۡبُدُوهَا وَأَنَابُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ لَهُمُ ٱلۡبُشۡرَىٰۚ فَبَشِّرۡ عِبَادِ ﴿١٧﴾ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسۡتَمِعُونَ ٱلۡقَوۡلَ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ أَحۡسَنَهُۥٓۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ هَدَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُۖ وَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمۡ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ ﴿١٨﴾
items.urdu: (17) اور جن لوگوں نے طاغوت کی عبادت سے پرہیز کیا اور (ہمہ تن) اللہ تعالیٰ کی طرف متوجہ رہے وه خوش خبری کے مستحق ہیں، میرے بندوں کو خوشخبری سنا دیجئے (18) جو بات کو کان لگا کر سنتے ہیں۔ پھر جو بہترین بات ہو اس کی اتباع کرتے ہیں۔ یہی ہیں جنہیں اللہ تعالیٰ نے ہدایت کی ہے اور یہی عقلمند بھی ہیں
items.english: (17) But those who have avoided Taghut, lest they worship it, and turned back to Allah - for them are good tidings. So give good tidings to My servants (18) Who listen to speech and follow the best of it. Those are the ones Allah has guided, and those are people of understanding
items.meaning:
Allah gives glad tidings to those who turned away from false gods and returned to Him — those who listen to what is said and follow the best of it.

These are the people He has guided and given real understanding.
items.reflection:
Let your excitement be for what is truly good.

Listen, choose the best, and receive His glad tidings.

items.title: Quran 57:21
items.arabic: سَابِقُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ مَغۡفِرَةࣲ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ وَجَنَّةٍ عَرۡضُهَا كَعَرۡضِ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ أُعِدَّتۡ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦۚ ذَٰلِكَ فَضۡلُ ٱللَّهِ يُؤۡتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلۡفَضۡلِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
items.urdu: (آؤ) دوڑو اپنے رب کی مغفرت کی طرف اور اس جنت کی طرف جس کی وسعت آسمان وزمین کی وسعت کے برابر ہے یہ ان کے لیے بنائی ہے جو اللہ پر اور اس کے رسولوں پر ایمان رکھتے ہیں۔ یہ اللہ کا فضل ہے جسے چاہے دے اور اللہ بڑے فضل واﻻ ہے
items.english: Race toward forgiveness from your Lord and a Garden whose width is like the width of the heavens and earth, prepared for those who believed in Allah and His messengers. That is the bounty of Allah which He gives to whom He wills, and Allah is the possessor of great bounty
items.meaning:
Allah invites us to race toward His forgiveness and a Garden as wide as the heavens and the earth, prepared for those who believe.

He calls it His bounty, given to whom He wills — and His bounty is vast.
items.reflection:
Put your energy into a race worth winning.

The prize is wider than the heavens and the earth.

items.title: Sunan Abi Dawud 2774
items.arabic: كَانَ إِذَا جَاءَهُ أَمْرُ سُرُورٍ أَوْ بُشِّرَ بِهِ خَرَّ سَاجِدًا شَاكِرًا لِلَّهِ
items.urdu: نبی اکرم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کے پاس جب کوئی خوشی کی بات آتی یا آپ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کو کوئی خوشخبری سنائی جاتی تو اللہ کا شکر ادا کرتے ہوئے سجدہ میں گر پڑتے
items.english: When anything came to the Prophet (ﷺ) which caused pleasure (or, by which he was made glad), he prostrated himself in gratitude to Allah
items.meaning:
When good news reached the Prophet ﷺ, he fell into prostration in gratitude to Allah.

Joy is not meant to pull us away from Allah; it is a reason to come closer.
items.reflection:
When good news reaches you, let your first response be gratitude.

Put your forehead down for the One who sent it.

items.title: Quran 2:152
items.arabic: فَٱذۡكُرُونِيٓ أَذۡكُرۡكُمۡ وَٱشۡكُرُواْ لِي وَلَا تَكۡفُرُونِ
items.urdu: اس لئے تم میرا ذکر کرو، میں بھی تمہیں یاد کروں گا، میری شکر گزاری کرو اور ناشکری سے بچو
items.english: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me
items.meaning:
Allah tells us: remember Me; I will remember you—and be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.

Remembrance is a mutual nearness: our dhikr is met by His care. Gratitude keeps the heart from covering over clear blessings.

A remembered Lord remembers His servant.
items.reflection:
Make space to remember Allah, and know that He remembers you.

Gratitude keeps the heart from forgetting who provides.

items.title: Quran 14:7
items.arabic: وَإِذۡ تَأَذَّنَ رَبُّكُمۡ لَئِن شَكَرۡتُمۡ لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمۡۖ وَلَئِن كَفَرۡتُمۡ إِنَّ عَذَابِي لَشَدِيدࣱ‏
items.urdu: اور جب تمہارے پروردگار نے تمہیں آگاه کر دیا کہ اگر تم شکر گزاری کرو گے تو بیشک میں تمہیں زیاده دوں گا اور اگر تم ناشکری کرو گے تو یقیناً میرا عذاب بہت سخت ہے
items.english: And [remember] when your Lord proclaimed, 'If you are grateful, I will surely increase you [in favor]; but if you deny, indeed, My punishment is severe
items.meaning:
Allah tells us that if we are grateful, He will surely increase us; and if we deny His favors, His punishment is severe.

Gratitude opens the door to more—more peace, more awareness, more blessing in what we already have.

Shukr is both thanks and a way of living awake to gifts.
items.reflection:
Practice gratitude, and watch how Allah expands what you have.

Thankfulness invites increase from the Most Generous.

items.title: Quran 16:18
items.arabic: وَإِن تَعُدُّواْ نِعۡمَةَ ٱللَّهِ لَا تُحۡصُوهَآۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَغَفُورࣱ رَّحِيمࣱ‏
items.urdu: اور اگر تم اللہ کی نعمتوں کا شمار کرنا چاہو تو تم اسے نہیں کر سکتے۔ بیشک اللہ بڑا بخشنے واﻻ مہربان ہے
items.english: And if you should count the favors of Allah, you could not enumerate them. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful
items.meaning:
Allah tells us that if we tried to count His favors, we could not enumerate them—and that He is Forgiving and Merciful.

Blessings surround us beyond what we notice: breath, guidance, second chances, unseen protection.

Awareness of countless favors softens the heart toward gratitude and hope.
items.reflection:
You are living inside more gifts than you can count.

Let that overwhelm turn into quiet thanks to the Forgiving, the Merciful.

items.title: Sahih Muslim 2734a
items.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَيَرْضَى عَنِ الْعَبْدِ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ الأَكْلَةَ فَيَحْمَدَهُ عَلَيْهَا أَوْ يَشْرَبَ الشَّرْبَةَ فَيَحْمَدَهُ عَلَيْهَا
items.urdu: اللہ تعالیٰ اس بات پر ( اپنے ) بندے سے راضی ہوتا ہے کہ وہ ایک کھانا کھائے اور اس پر اللہ کی حمد کرے یا پینے کی کوئی چیز ( پانی ، دودھ وغیرہ ) پیے اور اس پر اللہ کی حمد کرے
items.english: Allah is pleased with His servant who says: Al-Hamdu lillah while taking a morsel of food and while drinking.
items.meaning:
Saying Alhamdulillah over a single meal or drink earns Allah's pleasure.

The smallest blessings, noticed and thanked, become a door to His love.
items.reflection:
Thank Him for the ordinary things today — water, food, breath.

A grateful heart is built one Alhamdulillah at a time.

items.title: Quran 10:57-58
items.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ قَدۡ جَآءَتۡكُم مَّوۡعِظَةࣱ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ وَشِفَآءࣱ لِّمَا فِي ٱلصُّدُورِ وَهُدࣰ ى وَرَحۡمَةࣱ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ ﴿٥٧﴾ قُلۡ بِفَضۡلِ ٱللَّهِ وَبِرَحۡمَتِهِۦ فَبِذَٰلِكَ فَلۡيَفۡرَحُواْ هُوَ خَيۡرࣱ مِّمَّا يَجۡمَعُونَ ﴿٥٨﴾
items.urdu: (57) اے لوگو! تمہارے پاس تمہارے رب کی طرف سے ایک ایسی چیز آئی ہے جو نصیحت ہے اور دلوں میں جو روگ ہیں ان کے لیے شفا ہے اور رہنمائی کرنے والی ہے اور رحمت ہے ایمان والوں کے لیے (58) آپ کہہ دیجئے کہ بس لوگوں کو اللہ کے اس انعام اور رحمت پر خوش ہونا چاہئے۔ وه اس سے بدرجہا بہتر ہے جس کو وه جمع کر رہے ہیں
items.english: (57) O mankind, there has to come to you instruction from your Lord and healing for what is in the breasts and guidance and mercy for the believers (58) Say, "In the bounty of Allah and in His mercy - in that let them rejoice; it is better than what they accumulate"
items.meaning:
Allah tells all of humanity that guidance, healing for the hearts, and mercy have come from their Lord. Then He says: in the bounty of Allah and His mercy — in that let them rejoice; it is better than anything they collect.

The Quran itself is named as a reason for joy.
items.reflection:
Rejoice in what Allah has given you of guidance and mercy.

It outweighs everything the world can gather.

items.title: Quran 84:6-9
items.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدۡحࣰا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ ﴿٦﴾ فَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ ﴿٧﴾ فَسَوۡفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابࣰا يَسِيرࣰا ﴿٨﴾ وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ مَسۡرُورࣰا ﴿٩﴾
items.urdu: (6) اے انسان! تو اپنے رب سے ملنے تک یہ کوشش اور تمام کام اور محنتیں کرکے اس سے ملاقات کرنے واﻻ ہے (7) تو (اس وقت) جس شخص کے داہنے ہاتھ میں اعمال نامہ دیا جائے گا (8) اس کا حساب تو بڑی آسانی سے لیا جائے گا (9) اور وه اپنے اہل کی طرف ہنسی خوشی لوٹ آئے گا
items.english: (6) O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it (7) Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand (8) He will be judged with an easy account (9) And return to his people in happiness
items.meaning:
Allah tells every human being: you are striving hard toward your Lord, and you will meet Him. Whoever is given his record in his right hand will have an easy reckoning and return to his family overjoyed.

All the effort of life ends in this joy for the believer.
items.reflection:
Your effort is heading somewhere.

Let today's joy remind you of the joy of that return.

items.title: Jami' at-Tirmidhi 766
items.arabic: لِلصَّائِمِ فَرْحَتَانِ فَرْحَةٌ حِينَ يُفْطِرُ وَفَرْحَةٌ حِينَ يَلْقَى رَبَّهُ
items.urdu: روزہ دار کے لیے دو خوشیاں ہیں: ایک خوشی افطار کرتے وقت ہوتی ہے اور دوسری اس وقت ہو گی جب وہ اپنے رب سے ملے گا
items.english: There are two joys for the fasting person: the joy when he breaks his fast, and the joy of when he meets his Lord.
items.meaning:
The Prophet ﷺ teaches that the fasting person has two joys: joy when breaking the fast, and joy when meeting his Lord.

Discipline today holds a taste of relief at sunset and a greater joy in the Hereafter.

Worship carries both immediate and eternal sweetness.
items.reflection:
Let the joy of iftar remind you of a greater joy still coming.

Fasting links today’s patience to tomorrow’s meeting with Allah.

items.title: Quran 13:28
items.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَتَطۡمَئِنُّ قُلُوبُهُم بِذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِۗ أَلَا بِذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِ تَطۡمَئِنُّ ٱلۡقُلُوبُ
items.urdu: جو لوگ ایمان ﻻئے ان کے دل اللہ کے ذکر سے اطمینان حاصل کرتے ہیں۔ یاد رکھو اللہ کے ذکر سے ہی دلوں کو تسلی حاصل ہوتی ہے
items.english: Those who have believed and whose hearts are assured by the remembrance of Allah. Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts are assured
items.meaning:
Allah tells us that hearts find assurance through His remembrance—and that by the remembrance of Allah, hearts are assured.

Dhikr is not empty repetition; it is the means by which restless hearts settle.

Belief and remembrance together bring a calm the world cannot manufacture.
items.reflection:
When your heart races, remember Allah until it softens.

True assurance grows in His remembrance.

items.title: Quran 48:4
items.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنزَلَ ٱلسَّكِينَةَ فِي قُلُوبِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ لِيَزۡدَادُوٓاْ إِيمَٰنࣰا مَّعَ إِيمَٰنِهِمۡۗ وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمࣰا
items.urdu: وہی ہے جس نے مسلمانوں کے دلوں میں سکون (اور اطیمنان) ڈال دیا تاکہ اپنے ایمان کے ساتھ ہی ساتھ اور بھی ایمان میں بڑھ جائیں، اور آسمانوں اور زمین کے ﴿کل﴾ لشکر اللہ ہی کے ہیں۔ اور اللہ تعالیٰ دانا باحکمت ہے
items.english: It is He who sent down tranquillity into the hearts of the believers that they would increase in faith along with their [present] faith. And to Allah belong the soldiers of the heavens and the earth, and ever is Allah Knowing and Wise
items.meaning:
Allah tells us that He sent down tranquillity into the hearts of the believers so that they would increase in faith upon their faith.

Sakinah is a gift that settles the heart and deepens iman.

Calm from Allah is not emptiness—it is faith growing quieter and stronger.
items.reflection:
Ask Allah to send tranquillity into your heart.

His sakinah increases faith in ways force never could.

items.title: Quran 89:27-30
items.arabic: يَٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفۡسُ ٱلۡمُطۡمَئِنَّةُ ﴿٢٧﴾ ٱرۡجِعِيٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةࣰ مَّرۡضِيَّةࣰ‏ ﴿٢٨﴾ فَٱدۡخُلِي فِي عِبَٰدِي ﴿٢٩﴾ وَٱدۡخُلِي جَنَّتِي ﴿٣٠﴾
items.urdu: (27) اے اطمینان والی روح (28) تو اپنے رب کی طرف لوٹ چل اس طرح کہ تو اس سے راضی وه تجھ سے خوش (29) پس میرے خاص بندوں میں داخل ہو جا (30) اور میری جنت میں چلی جا
items.english: (27) [To the righteous it will be said], "O reassured soul (28) Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him] (29) And enter among My [righteous] servants (30) And enter My Paradise"
items.meaning:
Allah addresses the soul that found rest in Him: O reassured soul, return to your Lord, pleased and pleasing to Him. Enter among My servants, and enter My Paradise.

The four ayahs together describe the peaceful end of a life lived in trust.
items.reflection:
Peace with Allah is the peace that lasts.

Live in a way your soul would be glad to be called home from.

items.title: Quran 33:3
items.arabic: وَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى ٱللَّهِۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ وَكِيلࣰا
items.urdu: آپ اللہ ہی پر توکل رکھیں، وه کار سازی کے لئے کافی ہے
items.english: And rely upon Allah; and sufficient is Allah as Disposer of affairs
items.meaning:
Allah's instruction is simple: rely upon Him, and He is enough as the One who manages your affairs.

Assurance comes from handing your affairs to the One who never fails.
items.reflection:
Do what you can, then leave the rest to Him.

Allah is enough as your Disposer of affairs.

items.title: Quran 9:51
items.arabic: قُل لَّن يُصِيبَنَآ إِلَّا مَا كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ لَنَا هُوَ مَوۡلَىٰنَاۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلۡيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ
items.urdu: آپ کہہ دیجئے کہ ہمیں سوائے اللہ کے ہمارے حق میں لکھے ہوئے کہ کوئی چیز پہنچ ہی نہیں سکتی وه ہمارا کار ساز اور مولیٰ ہے۔ مومنوں کو تو اللہ کی ذات پاک پر ہی بھروسہ کرنا چاہئے۔
items.english: Say, "Never will we be struck except by what Allah has decreed for us; He is our protector." And upon Allah let the believers rely
items.meaning:
Allah tells us that believers should say they will never be struck except by what He has decreed—He is their protector—and upon Allah the believers rely.

Qadar and wilayah meet: nothing reaches you outside His decree, and He is the guardian you trust.

Tawakkul rests on that twin truth.
items.reflection:
Nothing hits you except what Allah decreed—and He is your protector.

Rely on Him with a settled heart.

items.title: Sahih al-Bukhari 7405
items.arabic: يَقُولُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى أَنَا عِنْدَ ظَنِّ عَبْدِي بِي، وَأَنَا مَعَهُ إِذَا ذَكَرَنِي، فَإِنْ ذَكَرَنِي فِي نَفْسِهِ ذَكَرْتُهُ فِي نَفْسِي، وَإِنْ ذَكَرَنِي فِي مَلأٍ ذَكَرْتُهُ فِي مَلأٍ خَيْرٍ مِنْهُمْ، وَإِنْ تَقَرَّبَ إِلَىَّ بِشِبْرٍ تَقَرَّبْتُ إِلَيْهِ ذِرَاعًا، وَإِنْ تَقَرَّبَ إِلَىَّ ذِرَاعًا تَقَرَّبْتُ إِلَيْهِ بَاعًا، وَإِنْ أَتَانِي يَمْشِي أَتَيْتُهُ هَرْوَلَةً
items.urdu: اللہ تعالیٰ فرماتا ہے کہ میں اپنے بندے کے گمان کے ساتھ ہوں اور جب وہ مجھے اپنے دل میں یاد کرتا ہے تو میں بھی اسے اپنے دل میں یاد کرتا ہوں اور جب وہ مجھے مجلس میں یاد کرتا ہے تو میں اسے اس سے بہتر فرشتوں کی مجلس میں اسے یاد کرتا ہوں اور اگر وہ مجھ سے ایک بالشت قریب آتا ہے تو میں اس سے ایک ہاتھ قریب ہو جاتا ہوں اور اگر وہ مجھ سے ایک ہاتھ قریب آتا ہے تو میں اس سے دو ہاتھ قریب ہو جاتا ہوں اور اگر وہ میری طرف چل کر آتا ہے تو میں اس کے پاس دوڑ کر آ جاتا ہوں
items.english: Allah says: 'I am just as My slave thinks I am, (i.e. I am able to do for him what he thinks I can do for him) and I am with him if He remembers Me. If he remembers Me in himself, I too, remember him in Myself; and if he remembers Me in a group of people, I remember him in a group that is better than they; and if he comes one span nearer to Me, I go one cubit nearer to him; and if he comes one cubit nearer to Me, I go a distance of two outstretched arms nearer to him; and if he comes to Me walking, I go to him running.
items.meaning:
This hadith shares Allah’s words: He is as His servant thinks of Him, and He is with the one who remembers Him.

If you remember Allah quietly, He remembers you; if you remember Him among people, He remembers you in a better gathering. As you draw near to Him, He draws nearer still.

Hopeful thoughts of Allah invite His nearness and generosity.
items.reflection:
Think well of Allah—He meets you according to that hope.

Every step you take toward remembrance, He comes closer still.

items.title: Quran 2:249
items.arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلۡجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبۡتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرࣲ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنۡهُ فَلَيۡسَ مِنِّي وَمَن لَّمۡ يَطۡعَمۡهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّيٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغۡتَرَفَ غُرۡفَةَۢ بِيَدِهِۦۚ فَشَرِبُواْ مِنۡهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلࣰا مِّنۡهُمۡۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مَعَهُۥ قَالُواْ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلۡيَوۡمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَٰقُواْ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةࣲ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتۡ فِئَةࣰ كَثِيرَةَۢ بِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
items.urdu: جب (حضرت) طالوت لشکروں کو لے کر نکلے تو کہا سنو اللہ تعالیٰ تمہیں ایک نہر سے آزمانے واﻻہے، جس نے اس میں سے پانی پی لیا وه میرا نہیں اور جو اسے نہ چکھے وه میرا ہے، ہاں یہ اور بات ہے کہ اپنے ہاتھ سے ایک چلو بھرلے۔ لیکن سوائے چند کے باقی سب نے وه پانی پی لیا (حضرت) طالوت مومنین سمیت جب نہر سے گزر گئے تو وه لوگ کہنے لگے آج تو ہم میں طاقت نہیں کہ جالوت اور اس کے لشکروں سے لڑیں۔ لیکن اللہ تعالیٰ کی ملاقات پر یقین رکھنے والوں نے کہا، بسا اوقات چھوٹی اور تھوڑی سی جماعتیں بڑی اور بہت سی جماعتوں پر اللہ کے حکم سے غلبہ پالیتی ہیں، اللہ تعالیٰ صبر والوں کے ساتھ ہے
items.english: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allah will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allah said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allah. And Allah is with the patient"
items.meaning:
This ayah recalls how a small group who trusted Allah said that victory can come through a few over many—by Allah’s permission—and how Allah is with the patient.

Numbers do not decide outcomes; Allah does. Patience and trust can outweigh apparent weakness.

Faith looks past odds to the One who grants success.
items.reflection:
Do not measure your hope only by how many stand with you.

Allah is with the patient, even when they seem few.

items.title: Quran 3:173-174
items.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ قَالَ لَهُمُ ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّ ٱلنَّاسَ قَدۡ جَمَعُواْ لَكُمۡ فَٱخۡشَوۡهُمۡ فَزَادَهُمۡ إِيمَٰنࣰا وَقَالُواْ حَسۡبُنَا ٱللَّهُ وَنِعۡمَ ٱلۡوَكِيلُ ﴿١٧٣﴾ فَٱنقَلَبُواْ بِنِعۡمَةࣲ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَفَضۡلࣲ لَّمۡ يَمۡسَسۡهُمۡ سُوٓءࣱ وَٱتَّبَعُواْ رِضۡوَٰنَ ٱللَّهِۗ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو فَضۡلٍ عَظِيمٍ ﴿١٧٤﴾
items.urdu: (173) وه لوگ کہ جب ان سے لوگوں نے کہا کہ کافروں نے تمہارے مقابلے پر لشکر جمع کر لئے ہیں، تم ان سے خوف کھاؤ تو اس بات نے انہیں ایمان میں اور بڑھا دیا اور کہنے لگے ہمیں اللہ کافی ہے اور وه بہت اچھا کارساز ہے (174) (نتیجہ یہ ہوا کہ) اللہ کی نعمت وفضل کے ساتھ یہ لوٹے، انہیں کوئی برائی نہ پہنچی، انہوں نے اللہ تعالیٰ کی رضامندی کی پیروی کی، اللہ بہت بڑے فضل واﻻ ہے
items.english: (173) Those to whom hypocrites said, "Indeed, the people have gathered against you, so fear them." But it [merely] increased them in faith, and they said, "Sufficient for us is Allah, and [He is] the best Disposer of affairs (174) So they returned with favor from Allah and bounty, no harm having touched them. And they pursued the pleasure of Allah, and Allah is the possessor of great bounty"
items.meaning:
When people warned the believers that a great army had gathered against them, it only increased their faith. They said: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs. They returned with favour and bounty from Allah, untouched by harm.

Hasbunallah turned fear into faith, and Allah protected them.
items.reflection:
When you are warned to be afraid, say what they said: Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal wakil.

Those words were followed by Allah's favour.

items.title: Sahih Muslim 2664
items.arabic: الْمُؤْمِنُ الْقَوِيُّ خَيْرٌ وَأَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِ الضَّعِيفِ وَفِي كُلٍّ خَيْرٌاحْرِصْ عَلَى مَا يَنْفَعُكَ وَاسْتَعِنْ بِاللَّهِ وَلاَ تَعْجِزْ وَإِنْ أَصَابَكَ شَىْءٌ فَلاَ تَقُلْ لَوْ أَنِّي فَعَلْتُ كَانَ كَذَا وَكَذَا ‏.‏ وَلَكِنْ قُلْ قَدَرُ اللَّهِ وَمَا شَاءَ فَعَلَ فَإِنَّ لَوْ تَفْتَحُ عَمَلَ الشَّيْطَانِ
items.urdu: طاقت ور مومن اللہ کے نزدیک کمزور مومن کی نسبت بہتر اور زیادہ محبوب ہے ، جبکہ خیر دونوں میں ( موجود ) ہے ۔ جس چیز سے تمہیں ( حقیقی ) نفع پہنچے اس میں حرص کرو اور اللہ سے مدد مانگو اور کمزور نہ پڑو ( مایوس ہو کر نہ بیٹھ ) جاؤ ، اگر تمہیں کوئی ( نقصان ) پہنچے تو یہ نہ کہو : کاش! میں ( اس طرح ) کرتا تو ایسا ایسا ہوتا ، بلکہ یہ کہو : ( یہ ) اللہ کی تقدیر ہے ، وہ جو چاہتا ہے کرتا ہے ، اس لیے کہ ( حشرت کرتے ہوئے ) کاش ( کہنا ) شیطان کے عمل ( کے دروازے ) کو کھول دیتا ہے
items.english: A strong believer is better and is more lovable to Allah than a weak believer, and there is good in everyone, (but) cherish that which gives you benefit (in the Hereafter) and seek help from Allah and do not lose heart, and if anything (in the form of trouble) comes to you, don't say: If I had not done that, it would not have happened so and so, but say: Allah did that what He had ordained to do and your" if" opens the (gate) for the Satan
items.meaning:
The strong believer is more beloved to Allah, and there is good in both. Strive for what benefits you, seek Allah's help, and do not give up. If something befalls you, don't say 'if only'; say 'Allah decreed, and He does what He wills'.

A full plan for getting up after a setback.
items.reflection:
Don't replay the loss. Say: Qaddarallahu wa ma sha'a fa'al.

Then get up and try again with His help.

items.title: Sahih al-Bukhari 2908
items.arabic: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَحْسَنَ النَّاسِ وَأَشْجَعَ النَّاسِ، وَلَقَدْ فَزِعَ أَهْلُ الْمَدِينَةِ لَيْلَةً فَخَرَجُوا نَحْوَ الصَّوْتِ فَاسْتَقْبَلَهُمُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَدِ اسْتَبْرَأَ الْخَبَرَ، وَهْوَ عَلَى فَرَسٍ لأَبِي طَلْحَةَ عُرْىٍ وَفِي عُنُقِهِ السَّيْفُ وَهْوَ يَقُولُ لَمْ تُرَاعُوا لَمْ تُرَاعُوا
items.urdu: نبی کریم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم سب سے زیادہ خوبصورت اور سب سے زیادہ بہادر تھے۔ ایک رات مدینہ پر ( ایک آواز سن کر ) بڑا خوف چھا گیا تھا، سب لوگ اس آواز کی طرف بڑھے لیکن نبی کریم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم سب سے آگے تھے اور آپ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم نے ہی واقعہ کی تحقیق کی۔ آپ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ابوطلحہ رضی اللہ عنہ کے ایک گھوڑے پر سوار تھے جس کی پشت ننگی تھی۔ آپ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کی گردن سے تلوار لٹک رہی تھی اور آپ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم فرما رہے تھے کہ ڈرو مت
items.english: The 'Prophet was the best and the bravest amongst the people. Once the people of Medina got terrified at night, so they went in the direction of the noise (that terrified them). The Prophet (ﷺ) met them (on his way back) after he had found out the truth. He was riding an unsaddled horse belonging to Abu Talha and a sword was hanging by his neck, and he was saying, "Don't be afraid! Don't be afraid!"
items.meaning:
This hadith shows the Prophet ﷺ as the bravest of people. When Medina was alarmed at night, he went ahead toward the sound while others were still gathering.

He returned calming them: “Don’t be afraid,” showing courage that protects others, not just oneself.

Faith can give steadiness when fear spreads through a community.
items.reflection:
Bravery in faith often looks like moving toward calm for others’ sake.

Ask Allah for a heart that steadies when panic rises.

items.title: Quran 3:200
items.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱصۡبِرُواْ وَصَابِرُواْ وَرَابِطُواْ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُفۡلِحُونَ
items.urdu: اے ایمان والو! تم ﺛابت قدم رہو اور ایک دوسرے کو تھامے رکھو اور جہاد کے لئے تیار رہو اور اللہ تعالیٰ سے ڈرتے رہو تاکہ تم مراد کو پہنچو
items.english: O you who have believed, persevere and endure and remain stationed and fear Allah that you may be successful
items.meaning:
Allah tells us that the believers to persevere, endure, remain stationed, and fear Allah so that they may be successful.

Success is tied to long patience, mutual steadfastness, and lasting taqwa.

The path asks for staying power, not only a strong start.
items.reflection:
Hold your ground with patience and God-consciousness.

Success grows from perseverance that does not quit.

items.title: Quran 41:30
items.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُواْ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَقَٰمُواْ تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ أَلَّا تَخَافُواْ وَلَا تَحۡزَنُواْ وَأَبۡشِرُواْ بِٱلۡجَنَّةِ ٱلَّتِي كُنتُمۡ تُوعَدُونَ
items.urdu: (واقعی) جن لوگوں نے کہا کہ ہمارا پروردگار اللہ ہے پھر اسی پر قائم رہے ان کے پاس فرشتے (یہ کہتے ہوئے آتے ہیں کہ تم کچھ بھی اندیشہ اور غم نہ کرو (بلکہ) اس جنت کی بشارت سن لو جس کا تم وعده دیئے گئے ہو
items.english: Indeed, those who have said, "Our Lord is Allah " and then remained on a right course - the angels will descend upon them, [saying], "Do not fear and do not grieve but receive good tidings of Paradise, which you were promised"
items.meaning:
Allah tells us that those who say “Our Lord is Allah” and then remain steadfast will have angels descend upon them, saying not to fear or grieve, and giving glad tidings of Paradise.

Iman followed by istiqamah draws divine comfort at life’s hardest crossings.

Angels become messengers of courage and hope.
items.reflection:
Say with your life that Allah is your Lord—and stay firm.

Steadfastness invites a comfort that tells you: do not fear, do not grieve.

items.title: Quran 42:43
items.arabic: وَلَمَن صَبَرَ وَغَفَرَ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمِنۡ عَزۡمِ ٱلۡأُمُورِ
items.urdu: اور جو شخص صبر کر لے اور معاف کردے یقیناً یہ بڑی ہمت کے کاموں میں سے (ایک کام) ہے
items.english: And whoever is patient and forgives - indeed, that is of the matters [requiring] determination
items.meaning:
Allah tells us that whoever is patient and forgives—indeed, that is of the matters requiring determination.

Sabr and pardon are not soft options; they are of the hardest, most resolute deeds.

True strength shows in enduring harm without returning it.
items.reflection:
Patience and forgiveness take real resolve.

Choose them when it would be easier to strike back.

items.title: Quran 46:35
items.arabic: فَٱصۡبِرۡ كَمَا صَبَرَ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡعَزۡمِ مِنَ ٱلرُّسُلِ وَلَا تَسۡتَعۡجِل لَّهُمۡۚ كَأَنَّهُمۡ يَوۡمَ يَرَوۡنَ مَا يُوعَدُونَ لَمۡ يَلۡبَثُوٓاْ إِلَّا سَاعَةࣰ مِّن نَّهَارِۭۚ بَلَٰغࣱۚ فَهَلۡ يُهۡلَكُ إِلَّا ٱلۡقَوۡمُ ٱلۡفَٰسِقُونَ
items.urdu: پس (اے پیغمبر!) تم ایسا صبر کرو جیسا صبر عالی ہمت رسولوں نے کیا اور ان کے لئے (عذاب طلب کرنے میں) جلدی نہ کرو، یہ جس دن اس عذاب کو دیکھ لیں گے جس کا وعده دیئے جاتے ہیں تو (یہ معلوم ہونے لگے گا کہ) دن کی ایک گھڑی ہی (دنیا میں) ٹھہرے تھے، یہ ہے پیغام پہنچا دینا، پس بدکاروں کے سوا کوئی ہلاک نہ کیا جائے گا
items.english: So be patient, [O Muhammad], as were those of determination among the messengers and do not be impatient for them. It will be - on the Day they see that which they are promised - as though they had not remained [in the world] except an hour of a day. [This is] notification. And will [any] be destroyed except the defiantly disobedient people
items.meaning:
Allah tells us that He instructed the Prophet ﷺ to be patient as were the messengers of determination, and not to be impatient for the outcome.

On the Day they are shown what they were promised, it will seem as if they had not remained except an hour of a day.

Waiting on Allah’s timing is part of prophetic character.
items.reflection:
Do not rush what Allah has timed with wisdom.

Patience places you in the company of the most determined messengers.

items.title: Sahih al-Bukhari 6338
items.arabic: إِذَا دَعَا أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَعْزِمِ الْمَسْأَلَةَ، وَلاَ يَقُولَنَّ اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ شِئْتَ فَأَعْطِنِي‏.‏ فَإِنَّهُ لاَ مُسْتَكْرِهَ لَهُ
items.urdu: جب تم میں سے کوئی دعا کرے تو اللہ سے قطعی طور پر مانگے اور یہ نہ کہے کہ اے اللہ! اگر تو چاہے تو مجھے عطا فرما کیونکہ اللہ پر کوئی زبردستی کرنے والا نہیں ہے
items.english: When anyone of you appeal to Allah for something, he should ask with determination and should not say, 'O Allah, if You wish, give me.', for nobody can force Allah to do something against His Will.
items.meaning:
The Prophet ﷺ teaches us to ask Allah with firm resolve, not with hesitant phrasing that weakens the ask—such as “if You wish, give me.”

Nothing can compel Allah against His will; determination in du‘a reflects trust that He hears and responds as He knows best.

Ask with hope, humility, and confidence in His generosity.
items.reflection:
Bring your needs to Allah with a heart that truly expects His response.

Certainty in asking is part of good manners with your Lord.

items.title: Quran 6:82
items.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَلَمۡ يَلۡبِسُوٓاْ إِيمَٰنَهُم بِظُلۡمٍأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ ٱلۡأَمۡنُ وَهُم مُّهۡتَدُونَ
items.urdu: جو لوگ ایمان رکھتے ہیں اور اپنے ایمان کو شرک کے ساتھ مخلوط نہیں کرتے، ایسوں ہی کے لئے امن ہے اور وہی راه راست پر چل رہے ہیں
items.english: They who believe and do not mix their belief with injustice - those will have security, and they are [rightly] guided
items.meaning:
Allah promises security (al-amn) and guidance to those who believe and do not mix their faith with wrongdoing.

Real safety is a heart at peace with its Lord.
items.reflection:
Security is not only locked doors; it is a clean heart before Allah.

Keep your faith pure and He will keep you safe.

items.title: Quran 10:62-64
items.arabic: أَلَآ إِنَّ أَوۡلِيَآءَ ٱللَّهِ لَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحۡزَنُونَ ﴿٦٢﴾ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَكَانُواْ يَتَّقُونَ ﴿٦٣﴾ لَهُمُ ٱلۡبُشۡرَىٰ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَفِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۚ لَا تَبۡدِيلَ لِكَلِمَٰتِ ٱللَّهِۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ ﴿٦٤﴾
items.urdu: (62) یاد رکھو اللہ کے دوستوں پر نہ کوئی اندیشہ ہے اور نہ وه غمگین ہوتے ہیں (63) یہ وه لوگ ہیں جو ایمان ﻻئے اور (برائیوں سے) پرہیز رکھتے ہیں (64) ان کے لیے دنیاوی زندگی میں بھی اور آخرت میں بھی خوش خبری ہے اللہ تعالیٰ کی باتوں میں کچھ فرق ہوا نہیں کرتا۔ یہ بڑی کامیابی ہے
items.english: (62) Unquestionably, [for] the allies of Allah there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve (63) Those who believed and were fearing Allah (64) For them are good tidings in the worldly life and in the Hereafter. No change is there in the words of Allah. That is what is the great attainment
items.meaning:
Allah declares that His close servants — those who believe and are mindful of Him — will have no fear and will not grieve. Good news is theirs in this life and in the Hereafter, and Allah's words do not change.

This is a guarantee from Allah Himself.
items.reflection:
Be among His allies through faith and mindfulness.

No fear and no grief — that is His unchanging promise.

items.title: Jami' at-Tirmidhi 2346
items.arabic: مَنْ أَصْبَحَ مِنْكُمْ آمِنًا فِي سِرْبِهِ مُعَافًى فِي جَسَدِهِ عِنْدَهُ قُوتُ يَوْمِهِ فَكَأَنَّمَا حِيزَتْ لَهُ الدُّنْيَا
items.urdu: تم میں سے جس نے بھی صبح کی اس حال میں کہ وہ اپنے گھر یا قوم میں امن سے ہو اور جسمانی لحاظ سے بالکل تندرست ہو اور دن بھر کی روزی اس کے پاس موجود ہو تو گویا اس کے لیے پوری دنیا سمیٹ دی گئی
items.english: Whoever among you wakes up in the morning secured in his dwelling, healthy in his body, having his food for the day,then it is as if the world has been gathered for him
items.meaning:
Whoever wakes up safe in his home, healthy in his body, with food for the day — it is as if the whole world has been gathered for him.

Security is already here more often than we notice.
items.reflection:
Count today's three gifts: safety, health, provision.

If you have them, you have the world.

items.title: Jami' at-Tirmidhi 2344
items.arabic: لَوْ أَنَّكُمْ كُنْتُمْ تَوَكَّلُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ حَقَّ تَوَكُّلِهِ لَرُزِقْتُمْ كَمَا تُرْزَقُ الطَّيْرُ تَغْدُو خِمَاصًا وَتَرُوحُ بِطَانًا
items.urdu: اگر تم لوگ اللہ پر توکل ( بھروسہ ) کرو جیسا کہ اس پر توکل ( بھروسہ ) کرنے کا حق ہے تو تمہیں اسی طرح رزق ملے گا جیسا کہ پرندوں کو ملتا ہے کہ صبح کو وہ بھوکے نکلتے ہیں اور شام کو آسودہ واپس آتے ہیں
items.english: If you were to rely upon Allah with the required reliance, then He would provide for you just as a bird is provided for, it goes out in the morning empty, and returns full.
items.meaning:
The Prophet ﷺ teaches that if we relied upon Allah with true reliance, He would provide for us as He provides for birds—they leave hungry in the morning and return full.

Tawakkul includes going out and trusting the Provider, not sitting still in despair.

Provision meets movement wrapped in trust.
items.reflection:
Rely on Allah like the bird that still flies out each morning.

Trust does not cancel effort; it frees effort from panic.

items.title: Quran 2:216
items.arabic: كُتِبَ عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡقِتَالُ وَهُوَ كُرۡهࣱ لَّكُمۡۖ وَعَسَىٰٓ أَن تَكۡرَهُواْ شَيۡـࣰٔا وَهُوَ خَيۡرࣱ لَّكُمۡۖ وَعَسَىٰٓ أَن تُحِبُّواْ شَيۡـࣰٔا وَهُوَ شَرࣱّ لَّكُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ وَأَنتُمۡ لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ
items.urdu: تم پر جہاد فرض کیا گیا گو وه تمہیں دشوار معلوم ہو، ممکن ہے کہ تم کسی چیز کو بری جانو اور دراصل وہی تمہارے لئے بھلی ہو اور یہ بھی ممکن ہے کہ تم کسی چیز کو اچھی سمجھو، حاﻻنکہ وه تمہارے لئے بری ہو، حقیقی علم اللہ ہی کو ہے، تم محض بےخبر ہو
items.english: Fighting has been enjoined upon you while it is hateful to you. But perhaps you hate a thing and it is good for you; and perhaps you love a thing and it is bad for you. And Allah Knows, while you know not
items.meaning:
Allah tells us that we may hate a thing while it is good for us, and love a thing while it is bad for us—and Allah knows while we do not know.

Our preferences are limited; His wisdom is complete.

What feels bitter may hold benefit we cannot yet see.
items.reflection:
Trust that Allah’s knowledge outruns your likes and dislikes.

What you resist today may be mercy unfolding slowly.

items.title: Quran 57:22-23
items.arabic: مَآ أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةࣲ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا فِيٓ أَنفُسِكُمۡ إِلَّا فِي كِتَٰبࣲ مِّن قَبۡلِ أَن نَّبۡرَأَهَآۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرࣱ‏ ﴿٢٢﴾ لِّكَيۡلَا تَأۡسَوۡاْ عَلَىٰ مَا فَاتَكُمۡ وَلَا تَفۡرَحُواْ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰكُمۡۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخۡتَالࣲ فَخُورٍ ﴿٢٣﴾
items.urdu: (22) نہ کوئی مصیبت دنیا میں آتی ہے نہ (خاص) تمہاری جانوں میں، مگر اس سے پہلے کہ ہم اس کو پیدا کریں وه ایک خاص کتاب میں لکھی ہوئی ہے، یہ (کام) اللہ تعالیٰ پر (بالکل) آسان ہے (23) تاکہ تم اپنے سے فوت شده کسی چیز پر رنجیده نہ ہو جایا کرو اور نہ عطا کرده چیز پر اترا جاؤ، اور اترانے والے شیخی خوروں کو اللہ پسند نہیں فرماتا
items.english: (22) No disaster strikes upon the earth or among yourselves except that it is in a register before We bring it into being - indeed that, for Allah, is easy (23) In order that you not despair over what has eluded you and not exult [in pride] over what He has given you. And Allah does not like everyone self-deluded and boastful
items.meaning:
Allah tells us that every hardship on earth or in ourselves was written before it happened. He tells us this so that we do not despair over what we lost, nor become arrogant over what we were given.

Knowing it was decreed softens disappointment.
items.reflection:
What passed you by was never meant for you.

Let that knowledge loosen the grip of disappointment.

items.title: Sahih Muslim 2999
items.arabic: عَجَبًا لأَمْرِ الْمُؤْمِنِ إِنَّ أَمْرَهُ كُلَّهُ خَيْرٌ وَلَيْسَ ذَاكَ لأَحَدٍ إِلاَّ لِلْمُؤْمِنِ إِنْ أَصَابَتْهُ سَرَّاءُ شَكَرَ فَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَهُ وَإِنْ أَصَابَتْهُ ضَرَّاءُ صَبَرَ فَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَهُ
items.urdu: مومن کا معاملہ عجیب ہے ۔ اس کا ہرمعاملہ اس کے لیے بھلائی کا ہے ۔ اور یہ بات مومن کے سوا کسی اور کومیسر نہیں ۔ اسے خوشی اور خوشحالی ملے توشکر کرتا ہے ۔ اور یہ اس کے لیے اچھا ہوتا ہے اور اگر اسے کوئی نقصان پہنچے تو ( اللہ کی رضا کے لیے ) صبر کر تا ہے ، یہ ( ابھی ) اس کے لیے بھلائی ہوتی ہے
items.english: Strange are the ways of a believer for there is good in every affair of his and this is not the case with anyone else except in the case of a believer for if he has an occasion to feel delight, he thanks (God), thus there is a good for him in it, and if he gets into trouble and shows resignation (and endures it patiently), there is a good for him in it.
items.meaning:
The Prophet ﷺ marvels at the believer’s affair: there is good for him in every situation.

If something delightful comes, he thanks Allah—and that is good for him. If hardship comes and he shows patience—that too is good for him.

This beautiful outlook belongs uniquely to the believer who meets life with shukr and sabr.
items.reflection:
In ease, thank Him; in hardship, be patient—both are paths of good.

Nothing that reaches a believing heart has to be empty of meaning.

items.title: Quran 13:28
items.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَتَطۡمَئِنُّ قُلُوبُهُم بِذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِۗ أَلَا بِذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِ تَطۡمَئِنُّ ٱلۡقُلُوبُ
items.urdu: جو لوگ ایمان ﻻئے ان کے دل اللہ کے ذکر سے اطمینان حاصل کرتے ہیں۔ یاد رکھو اللہ کے ذکر سے ہی دلوں کو تسلی حاصل ہوتی ہے
items.english: Those who have believed and whose hearts are assured by the remembrance of Allah. Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts are assured
items.meaning:
Allah tells us that hearts find assurance through His remembrance—and that by the remembrance of Allah, hearts are assured.

Dhikr is not empty repetition; it is the means by which restless hearts settle.

Belief and remembrance together bring a calm the world cannot manufacture.
items.reflection:
When your heart races, remember Allah until it softens.

True assurance grows in His remembrance.

items.title: Quran 39:22
items.arabic: أَفَمَن شَرَحَ ٱللَّهُ صَدۡرَهُۥ لِلۡإِسۡلَٰمِ فَهُوَ عَلَىٰ نُورࣲ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦۚ فَوَيۡلࣱ لِّلۡقَٰسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مِّن ذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ فِي ضَلَٰلࣲ مُّبِينٍ
items.urdu: کیا وه شخص جس کا سینہ اللہ تعالیٰ نےاسلام کے لئے کھول دیا ہے پس وه اپنے پروردگار کی طرف سے ایک نور پر ہے اور ہلاکی ہے ان پر جن کے دل یاد الٰہی سے (اﺛر نہیں لیتے بلکہ) سخت ہو گئے ہیں۔ یہ لوگ صریح گمراہی میں (مبتلا) ہیں
items.english: So is one whose breast Allah has expanded to [accept] Islam and he is upon a light from his Lord [like one whose heart rejects it]? Then woe to those whose hearts are hardened against the remembrance of Allah. Those are in manifest error
items.meaning:
Allah tells us to consider whether one whose breast He has expanded to Islam—walking in light from his Lord—is like one whose heart is hardened against Allah’s remembrance.

An opened chest and inner light are gifts that make faith feel spacious.

Hardness toward dhikr is a loss; expansion toward Islam is mercy.
items.reflection:
Ask Allah to expand your chest with Islam and fill it with His light.

A soft, remembering heart is a treasure from Him.

items.title: Quran 16:97
items.arabic: مَنۡ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحࣰا مِّن ذَكَرٍأَوۡ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤۡمِنࣱ فَلَنُحۡيِيَنَّهُۥ حَيَوٰةࣰ طَيِّبَةࣰۖ وَلَنَجۡزِيَنَّهُمۡ أَجۡرَهُم بِأَحۡسَنِ مَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
items.urdu: جو شخص نیک عمل کرے مرد ہو یا عورت، لیکن باایمان ہو تو ہم اسے یقیناً نہایت بہتر زندگی عطا فرمائیں گے۔ اور ان کے نیک اعمال کا بہتر بدلہ بھی انہیں ضرور ضرور دیں گے
items.english: Whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while he is a believer - We will surely cause him to live a good life, and We will surely give them their reward [in the Hereafter] according to the best of what they used to do
items.meaning:
Allah promises a good life (hayatan tayyibah) to every believer, man or woman, who does good — and reward according to the best of what they did.

Fullness of life is promised through faith and good deeds, not possessions.
items.reflection:
Do one good thing today with faith in your heart.

This is how Allah fills an empty life with meaning.

items.title: Sahih al-Bukhari 6407
items.arabic: مَثَلُ الَّذِي يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ وَالَّذِي لاَ يَذْكُرُ مَثَلُ الْحَىِّ وَالْمَيِّتِ
items.urdu: اس شخص کی مثال جو اپنے رب کو یاد کرتا ہے اور اس کی مثال جو اپنے رب کو یاد نہیں کرتا زندہ اور مردہ جیسی ہے
items.english: The example of the one who celebrates the Praises of his Lord (Allah) in comparison to the one who does not celebrate the Praises of his Lord, is that of a living creature compared to a dead one.
items.meaning:
The Prophet ﷺ compares the one who remembers his Lord and the one who doesn't to the living and the dead.

The feeling of emptiness can be a sign that the heart is thirsty for dhikr.
items.reflection:
Begin with one small remembrance: SubhanAllah, Alhamdulillah, Allahu Akbar.

Let your heart come back to life slowly.

items.title: Quran 2:155-157
items.arabic: وَلَنَبۡلُوَنَّكُم بِشَيۡءࣲ مِّنَ ٱلۡخَوۡفِ وَٱلۡجُوعِ وَنَقۡصࣲ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَمۡوَٰلِ وَٱلۡأَنفُسِ وَٱلثَّمَرَٰتِۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ ﴿١٥٥﴾ ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَصَٰبَتۡهُم مُّصِيبَةࣱ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّآ إِلَيۡهِ رَٰجِعُونَ ﴿١٥٦﴾ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ صَلَوَٰتࣱ مِّن رَّبِّهِمۡ وَرَحۡمَةࣱۖ وَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُهۡتَدُونَ ﴿١٥٧﴾
items.urdu: (155) اور ہم کسی نہ کسی طرح تمہاری آزمائش ضرور کریں گے، دشمن کے ڈر سے، بھوک پیاس سے، مال وجان اور پھلوں کی کمی سے اور ان صبر کرنے والوں کو خوشخبری دے دیجیئے (156) جنہیں، جب کبھی کوئی مصیبت آتی ہے تو کہہ دیا کرتے ہیں کہ ہم تو خود اللہ تعالیٰ کی ملکیت ہیں اور ہم اسی کی طرف لوٹنے والے ہیں (157) ان پر ان کے رب کی نوازشیں اور رحمتیں ہیں اور یہی لوگ ہدایت یافتہ ہیں
items.english: (155) And We will surely test you with something of fear and hunger and a loss of wealth and lives and fruits, but give good tidings to the patient (156) Who, when disaster strikes them, say, "Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we will return (157) Those are the ones upon whom are blessings from their Lord and mercy. And it is those who are the [rightly] guided"
items.meaning: Allah tells us that life will include tests — fear, hunger, and loss of wealth, lives and fruits — and gives glad tidings to the patient. The patient are those who, when struck by loss, say: we belong to Allah and to Him we return. Upon them are blessings and mercy from their Lord, and they are the rightly guided.
items.reflection:
Your loss is seen, and your patience is promised mercy.

Say it softly, even through tears: Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un.

items.title: Quran 12:84-86
items.arabic: وَتَوَلَّىٰ عَنۡهُمۡ وَقَالَ يَٰٓأَسَفَىٰ عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ وَٱبۡيَضَّتۡ عَيۡنَاهُ مِنَ ٱلۡحُزۡنِ فَهُوَ كَظِيمࣱ‏ ﴿٨٤﴾ قَالُواْ تَٱللَّهِ تَفۡتَؤُاْ تَذۡكُرُ يُوسُفَ حَتَّىٰ تَكُونَ حَرَضًا أَوۡ تَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡهَٰلِكِينَ ﴿٨٥﴾ قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَشۡكُواْ بَثِّي وَحُزۡنِيٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَعۡلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ ﴿٨٦﴾
items.urdu: (84) پھر ان سے منھ پھیر لیا اور کہا ہائے یوسف! ان کی آنکھیں بوجہ رنج وغم کے سفید ہو چکی تھیں اور وه غم کو دبائے ہوئے تھے (85) بیٹوں نے کہا واللہ! آپ ہمیشہ یوسف کی یاد ہی میں لگے رہیں گے یہاں تک کہ گھل جائیں یا ختم ہی ہو جائیں (86) انہوں نے کہا کہ میں تو اپنی پریشانیوں اور رنج کی فریاد اللہ ہی سے کر رہا ہوں، مجھے اللہ کی طرف سے وه باتیں معلوم ہیں جو تم نہیں جانتے
items.english: (84) And he turned away from them and said, "Oh, my sorrow over Joseph," and his eyes became white from grief, for he was [of that] a suppressor (85) They said, "By Allah, you will not cease remembering Joseph until you become fatally ill or become of those who perish (86) He said, "I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allah, and I know from Allah that which you do not know
items.meaning:
Ya'qub (as), grieving for Yusuf, turned away and said: Oh, my sorrow for Yusuf — and his eyes turned white from grief while he held it in. His sons said he would ruin himself remembering Yusuf. He replied: I only complain of my sorrow and grief to Allah, and I know from Allah what you do not know.

A prophet wept openly, yet poured his grief out only to Allah — and he never lost hope.
items.reflection:
Grief does not mean weak faith; even a prophet wept.

Take your sorrow to Allah, and keep knowing what He knows.

items.title: Sahih al-Bukhari 1283
items.arabic: مَرَّ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِامْرَأَةٍ تَبْكِي عِنْدَ قَبْرٍ فَقَالَ اتَّقِي اللَّهَ وَاصْبِرِي . قَالَتْ إِلَيْكَ عَنِّي، فَإِنَّكَ لَمْ تُصَبْ بِمُصِيبَتِي، وَلَمْ تَعْرِفْهُ. فَقِيلَ لَهَا إِنَّهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم. فَأَتَتْ باب النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمْ تَجِدْ عِنْدَهُ بَوَّابِينَ فَقَالَتْ لَمْ أَعْرِفْكَ. فَقَالَ إِنَّمَا الصَّبْرُ عِنْدَ الصَّدْمَةِ الأُولَى
items.urdu: نبی کریم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کا گزر ایک عورت پر ہوا جو قبر پر بیٹھی رو رہی تھی۔ آپ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم نے فرمایا کہ اللہ سے ڈر اور صبر کر۔ وہ بولی جاؤ جی پرے ہٹو۔ یہ مصیبت تم پر پڑی ہوتی تو پتہ چلتا۔ وہ آپ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کو پہچان نہ سکی تھی۔ پھر جب لوگوں نے اسے بتایا کہ یہ نبی کریم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم تھے، تو اب وہ ( گھبرا کر ) نبی کریم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کے دروازہ پر پہنچی۔ وہاں اسے کوئی دربان نہ ملا۔ پھر اس نے کہا کہ میں آپ کو پہچان نہ سکی تھی۔ ( معاف فرمائیے ) تو آپ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم نے فرمایا کہ صبر تو جب صدمہ شروع ہو اس وقت کرنا چاہیے
items.english: The Prophet (ﷺ) passed by a woman who was weeping beside a grave. He told her to fear Allah and be patient. She said to him, "Go away, for you have not been afflicted with a calamity like mine." And she did not recognize him. Then she was informed that he was the Prophet (ﷺ) . so she went to the house of the Prophet (ﷺ) and there she did not find any guard. Then she said to him, "I did not recognize you." He said, "Verily, the patience is at the first stroke of a calamity"
items.meaning:
This hadith shows a grieving woman by a grave who was told to be patient, yet she did not recognize the Prophet ﷺ and pushed him away in her pain.

When she later learned who he was, he taught her that real patience is at the first strike of calamity—when the shock is freshest.

Grief is human; the call is to hold onto Allah even in the first wave of hurt.
items.reflection:
Patience is hardest—and most rewarded—at the beginning of loss.

Even when pain clouds recognition, returning to Allah remains open.

items.title: Sahih al-Bukhari 1303
items.arabic: فَقَالَ لَهُ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَوْفٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ وَأَنْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ يَا ابْنَ عَوْفٍ إِنَّهَا رَحْمَةٌ . ثُمَّ أَتْبَعَهَا بِأُخْرَى فَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِنَّ الْعَيْنَ تَدْمَعُ، وَالْقَلْبَ يَحْزَنُ، وَلاَ نَقُولُ إِلاَّ مَا يَرْضَى رَبُّنَا، وَإِنَّا بِفِرَاقِكَ يَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ لَمَحْزُونُونَ
items.urdu: تو عبدالرحمٰن بن عوف رضی اللہ عنہ بول پڑے کہ یا رسول اللہ! اور آپ بھی لوگوں کی طرح بے صبری کرنے لگے؟ نبی کریم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم نے فرمایا ‘ ابن عوف! یہ بے صبری نہیں یہ تو رحمت ہے۔ پھر آپ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم دوبارہ روئے اور فرمایا۔ آنکھوں سے آنسو جاری ہیں اور دل غم سے نڈھال ہے پر زبان سے ہم کہیں گے وہی جو ہمارے پروردگار کو پسند ہے اور اے ابراہیم! ہم تمہاری جدائی سے غمگین ہیں
items.english: `Abdur Rahman bin `Auf said, "O Allah's Apostle, even you are weeping!" He said, "O Ibn `Auf, this is mercy." Then he wept more and said, "The eyes are shedding tears and the heart is grieved, and we will not say except what pleases our Lord, O Ibrahim ! Indeed we are grieved by your separation"
items.meaning:
This hadith shows the Prophet ﷺ weeping at the death of his infant son Ibrahim.

When asked about his tears, he said they were mercy. His eyes shed tears and his heart grieved, yet he would only say what pleased his Lord.

Islam does not ask us to freeze our feelings; it teaches us to grieve with dignity and trust.
items.reflection:
Tears are not a lack of faith—they can be mercy.

You may feel deep sadness and still keep your tongue soft with Allah.

items.title: Sahih Muslim 923a
items.arabic: ارْجِعْ إِلَيْهَا فَأَخْبِرْهَا إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا أَخَذَ وَلَهُ مَا أَعْطَى وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى فَمُرْهَا فَلْتَصْبِرْ وَلْتَحْتَسِبْ
items.urdu: اللہ ہی کا ہے جو اس نے لے لیا اوراسی کا ہے ۔ جو اس نے دیا تھا اور اس کے ہاں ہر چیز کا وقت مقرر ہے ، اور ان کو بتادو کہ وہ صبر کریں اور اجر وثواب کی طلب گار ہوں
items.english: What Allah had taken belonged to Him, and to him belonged what He granted; and He has an appointed time for everything. So you (the messenger) order her to show endurance and seek reward from Allah
items.meaning:
This hadith shows the Prophet ﷺ weeping as a child’s soul departed, his eyes welling with tears of mercy.

When companions were surprised, he affirmed that this was compassion—not a lack of trust in Allah.

The most complete faith can still feel the ache of loss.
items.reflection:
Mercy softens the eyes without weakening the heart’s trust.

You may weep and still belong fully to Allah.

items.title: Sahih Muslim 918a
items.arabic: مَا مِنْ مُسْلِمٍ تُصِيبُهُ مُصِيبَةٌ فَيَقُولُ مَا أَمَرَهُ اللَّهُ إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا . إِلاَّ أَخْلَفَ اللَّهُ لَهُ خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
items.urdu: کوئی مسلمان نہیں جسے مصیبت پہنچے اور وہ ( وہی کچھ ) کہے جس کا اللہ نے اسے حکم دیا ہے : یقینا ہم اللہ کے ہیں اور اسی کی طرف لوٹنے والے ہیں ، اے اللہ!مجھے میری مصیبت پر اجر دے اور مجھے ( اس کا ) اس سے بہتر بدل عطا فرما مگر اللہ تعالیٰ اسے اس ( ضائع شدہ چیز ) کا بہتر بدل عطا فرمادیتا ہے
items.english: If any Muslim who suffers some calamity says, what Allah has commanded him," We belong to Allah and to Him shall we return; O Allah, reward me for my affliction and give me something better than it in exchange for it," Allah will give him something better than it in exchange
items.meaning: The Prophet ﷺ taught what to say at a loss: we belong to Allah and to Him we return; O Allah, reward me in my calamity and replace it for me with something better. Umm Salamah said this when her husband died, and Allah gave her the Prophet ﷺ as her husband.
items.reflection:
When you have no words, use these.

Allah can compensate in ways you cannot imagine yet.

items.title: Quran 2:186
items.arabic: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌۖ أُجِيبُ دَعۡوَةَ ٱلدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِۖ فَلۡيَسۡتَجِيبُواْ لِي وَلۡيُؤۡمِنُواْ بِي لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡشُدُونَ
items.urdu: جب میرے بندے میرے بارے میں آپ سے سوال کریں تو آپ کہہ دیں کہ میں بہت ہی قریب ہوں ہر پکارنے والے کی پکار کو جب کبھی وه مجھے پکارے، قبول کرتا ہوں اس لئے لوگوں کو بھی چاہئے کہ وه میری بات مان لیا کریں اور مجھ پر ایمان رکھیں، یہی ان کی بھلائی کا باعﺚ ہے
items.english: And when My servants ask you, [O Muhammad], concerning Me - indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me. So let them respond to Me [by obedience] and believe in Me that they may be [rightly] guided
items.meaning:
When Allah's servants ask about Him, He answers directly: I am near. I respond to the call of the one who calls upon Me.

No one who turns to Allah is truly alone.
items.reflection:
When no one seems to hear you, He does.

Speak to Him; He is closer than you think.

items.title: Quran 9:40
items.arabic: إِلَّا تَنصُرُوهُ فَقَدۡ نَصَرَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِذۡ أَخۡرَجَهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ ثَانِيَ ٱثۡنَيۡنِ إِذۡ هُمَا فِي ٱلۡغَارِ إِذۡ يَقُولُ لِصَٰحِبِهِۦ لَا تَحۡزَنۡ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَنَاۖ فَأَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُۥ عَلَيۡهِ وَأَيَّدَهُۥ بِجُنُودࣲ لَّمۡ تَرَوۡهَا وَجَعَلَ كَلِمَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ ٱلسُّفۡلَىٰۗ وَكَلِمَةُ ٱللَّهِ هِيَ ٱلۡعُلۡيَاۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
items.urdu: اگر تم ان (نبی صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم) کی مدد نہ کرو تو اللہ ہی نے ان کی مدد کی اس وقت جبکہ انہیں کافروں نے (دیس سے) نکال دیا تھا، دو میں سے دوسرا جبکہ وه دونوں غار میں تھے جب یہ اپنے ساتھی سے کہہ رہے تھے کہ غم نہ کر اللہ ہمارے ساتھ ہے، پس جناب باری نے اپنی طرف سے تسکین اس پر نازل فرما کر ان لشکروں سے اس کی مدد کی جنہیں تم نے دیکھا ہی نہیں، اس نے کافروں کی بات پست کر دی اور بلند وعزیز تو اللہ کا کلمہ ہی ہے، اللہ غالب ہے حکمت واﻻ ہے
items.english: If you do not aid the Prophet - Allah has already aided him when those who disbelieved had driven him out [of Makkah] as one of two, when they were in the cave and he said to his companion, "Do not grieve; indeed Allah is with us." And Allah sent down his tranquillity upon him and supported him with angels you did not see and made the word of those who disbelieved the lowest, while the word of Allah - that is the highest. And Allah is Exalted in Might and Wise
items.meaning:
Allah tells us of the cave: when the Prophet ﷺ said to his companion, “Do not grieve; indeed Allah is with us,” and Allah sent down tranquillity and support.

In the tightest hiding place, presence of Allah replaced grief.

“Allah is with us” remains a refuge when you feel hunted by fear.
items.reflection:
When grief closes in, remember: Allah is with us.

His tranquillity can fill even the narrowest cave.

items.title: Quran 57:4
items.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامࣲ ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِۖ يَعۡلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا يَخۡرُجُ مِنۡهَا وَمَا يَنزِلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا يَعۡرُجُ فِيهَاۖ وَهُوَ مَعَكُمۡ أَيۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ بَصِيرࣱ‏
items.urdu: وہی ہے جس نے آسمانوں اور زمین کو چھ دن میں پیدا کیا پھر عرش پر مستوی ہو گیا۔ وه (خوب) جانتا ہےاس چیز کو جو زمین میں جائے اور جو اس سے نکلے اور جو آسمان سے نیچے آئے اور جو کچھ چڑھ کر اس میں جائے، اور جہاں کہیں تم ہو وه تمہارے ساتھ ہے اور جو تم کر رہے ہو اللہ دیکھ رہا ہے
items.english: It is He who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne. He knows what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein; and He is with you wherever you are. And Allah, of what you do, is Seeing
items.meaning:
Allah tells us that He created the heavens and earth, knows what enters and emerges from the earth and what descends and ascends, and that He is with you wherever you are—and He sees what you do.

His knowledge and with-ness cover every place and state.

You are never outside His sight or care.
items.reflection:
Wherever you are, Allah is with you and sees you.

Let that closeness comfort you and gently guide your choices.

items.title: Sahih al-Bukhari 7405
items.arabic: يَقُولُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى أَنَا عِنْدَ ظَنِّ عَبْدِي بِي، وَأَنَا مَعَهُ إِذَا ذَكَرَنِي، فَإِنْ ذَكَرَنِي فِي نَفْسِهِ ذَكَرْتُهُ فِي نَفْسِي، وَإِنْ ذَكَرَنِي فِي مَلأٍ ذَكَرْتُهُ فِي مَلأٍ خَيْرٍ مِنْهُمْ، وَإِنْ تَقَرَّبَ إِلَىَّ بِشِبْرٍ تَقَرَّبْتُ إِلَيْهِ ذِرَاعًا، وَإِنْ تَقَرَّبَ إِلَىَّ ذِرَاعًا تَقَرَّبْتُ إِلَيْهِ بَاعًا، وَإِنْ أَتَانِي يَمْشِي أَتَيْتُهُ هَرْوَلَةً
items.urdu: اللہ تعالیٰ فرماتا ہے کہ میں اپنے بندے کے گمان کے ساتھ ہوں اور جب وہ مجھے اپنے دل میں یاد کرتا ہے تو میں بھی اسے اپنے دل میں یاد کرتا ہوں اور جب وہ مجھے مجلس میں یاد کرتا ہے تو میں اسے اس سے بہتر فرشتوں کی مجلس میں اسے یاد کرتا ہوں اور اگر وہ مجھ سے ایک بالشت قریب آتا ہے تو میں اس سے ایک ہاتھ قریب ہو جاتا ہوں اور اگر وہ مجھ سے ایک ہاتھ قریب آتا ہے تو میں اس سے دو ہاتھ قریب ہو جاتا ہوں اور اگر وہ میری طرف چل کر آتا ہے تو میں اس کے پاس دوڑ کر آ جاتا ہوں
items.english: Allah says: 'I am just as My slave thinks I am, (i.e. I am able to do for him what he thinks I can do for him) and I am with him if He remembers Me. If he remembers Me in himself, I too, remember him in Myself; and if he remembers Me in a group of people, I remember him in a group that is better than they; and if he comes one span nearer to Me, I go one cubit nearer to him; and if he comes one cubit nearer to Me, I go a distance of two outstretched arms nearer to him; and if he comes to Me walking, I go to him running.
items.meaning:
This hadith shares Allah’s words: He is as His servant thinks of Him, and He is with the one who remembers Him.

If you remember Allah quietly, He remembers you; if you remember Him among people, He remembers you in a better gathering. As you draw near to Him, He draws nearer still.

Hopeful thoughts of Allah invite His nearness and generosity.
items.reflection:
Think well of Allah—He meets you according to that hope.

Every step you take toward remembrance, He comes closer still.

items.title: Quran 16:127
items.arabic: وَٱصۡبِرۡ وَمَا صَبۡرُكَ إِلَّا بِٱللَّهِۚ وَلَا تَحۡزَنۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا تَكُ فِي ضَيۡقࣲ مِّمَّا يَمۡكُرُونَ
items.urdu: آپ صبر کریں بغیر توفیق الٰہی کے آپ صبر کر ہی نہیں سکتے اور ان کے حال پر رنجیده نہ ہوں اور جو مکر وفریب یہ کرتے رہتے ہیں ان سے تنگ دل نہ ہوں
items.english: And be patient, [O Muhammad], and your patience is not but through Allah. And do not grieve over them and do not be in distress over what they conspire
items.meaning:
Allah tells us that He instructed the Prophet ﷺ to be patient—and that patience comes only through Allah—and not to grieve over those who turn away or feel distress because of their plots.

Sabr is sustained by Allah’s help, not by sheer willpower alone.

We are invited to release what we cannot control into His care.
items.reflection:
Ask Allah for the patience you cannot produce alone.

Do not let others’ rejection consume the peace He wants for your heart.

items.title: Quran 28:7
items.arabic: وَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنۡ أَرۡضِعِيهِۖ فَإِذَا خِفۡتِ عَلَيۡهِ فَأَلۡقِيهِ فِي ٱلۡيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِي وَلَا تَحۡزَنِيٓۖ إِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ إِلَيۡكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
items.urdu: ہم نے موسیٰ (علیہ السلام) کی ماں کو وحی کی کہ اسے دودھ پلاتی ره اور جب تجھے اس کی نسبت کوئی خوف معلوم ہو تو اسے دریا میں بہا دینا اور کوئی ڈر خوف یا رنج غم نہ کرنا، ہم یقیناً اسے تیری طرف لوٹانے والے ہیں اور اسے اپنے پیغمبروں میں بنانے والے ہیں
items.english: And We inspired to the mother of Moses, "Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers"
items.meaning:
Allah inspired the mother of Musa: nurse him, and when you fear for him, place him in the river — do not fear and do not grieve. We will return him to you and make him one of the messengers.

Allah spoke directly to a mother's fear and sorrow, and kept His promise.
items.reflection:
What you fear losing is in Allah's care.

He can return it to you better than before.

items.title: Sahih Muslim 2573
items.arabic: مَا يُصِيبُ الْمُؤْمِنَ مِنْ وَصَبٍ وَلاَ نَصَبٍ وَلاَ سَقَمٍ وَلاَ حَزَنٍ حَتَّى الْهَمِّ يُهَمُّهُ إِلاَّ كُفِّرَ بِهِ مِنْ سَيِّئَاتِهِ
items.urdu: مومن کو کوئی تکلیف نہیں پہنچتی ، نہ تھکاوٹ ، نہ بیماری ، نہ غم حتی کہ کوئی فکر بھی جو اسے فکرمند کر دے مگر اس کے بدلے اس کے گناہوں کو مٹا دیا جاتا ہے
items.english: Never a believer is stricken with discomfort, hardship or illness, grief or even with mental worry that his sins are not expiated for him
items.meaning:
This hadith reminds us that no pain or suffering a believer experiences goes unnoticed by Allah.

Whether you’re experiencing physical pain, emotional distress, sadness, anxiety, or exhaustion, Allah can make these hardships a means of forgiveness.

Even something as small as being pricked by a thorn can become a reason for sins to be erased.
items.reflection:
Your suffering is never meaningless in the sight of Allah.

Sometimes, the difficulties we experience become a means through which Allah purifies us of our sins.

items.title: Sahih al-Bukhari 6369
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ، وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
items.urdu: اے اللہ! میں تیری پناہ مانگتا ہوں غم و الم سے، عاجزی سے، سستی سے، بزدلی سے، بخل، قرض چڑھ جانے اور لوگوں کے غلبہ سے
items.english: O Allah! I seek refuge with You from worry and grief, from incapacity and laziness, from cowardice and miserliness, from being heavily in debt and from being overpowered by (other) men.
items.meaning:
The Prophet ﷺ used to seek refuge in Allah from worry and grief, from incapacity and laziness, from cowardice and miserliness, and from crushing debt and being overpowered by people.

This dua shows that emotional burdens, spiritual stagnation, and worldly pressures are all things we may bring to Allah.

Even the Messenger ﷺ modeled asking for protection from what weighs on the heart.
items.reflection:
You are allowed to name your fears before Allah.

Seek His refuge from worry, grief, and whatever leaves you feeling small or stuck.

items.title: Quran 2:286
items.arabic: لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفۡسًا إِلَّا وُسۡعَهَاۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتۡ وَعَلَيۡهَا مَا ٱكۡتَسَبَتۡۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذۡنَآ إِن نَّسِينَآ أَوۡ أَخۡطَأۡنَاۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحۡمِلۡ عَلَيۡنَآ إِصۡرࣰا كَمَا حَمَلۡتَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِنَاۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلۡنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦۖ وَٱعۡفُ عَنَّا وَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَٱرۡحَمۡنَآۚ أَنتَ مَوۡلَىٰنَا فَٱنصُرۡنَا عَلَى ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
items.urdu: اللہ تعالیٰ کسی جان کو اس کی طاقت سے زیاده تکلیف نہیں دیتا، جو نیکی وه کرے وه اس کے لئے اور جو برائی وه کرے وه اس پر ہے، اے ہمارے رب! اگر ہم بھول گئے ہوں یا خطا کی ہو تو ہمیں نہ پکڑنا، اے ہمارے رب! ہم پر وه بوجھ نہ ڈال جو ہم سے پہلے لوگوں پر ڈاﻻ تھا، اے ہمارے رب! ہم پر وه بوجھ نہ ڈال جس کی ہمیں طاقت نہ ہو اور ہم سے درگزر فرما! اور ہمیں بخش دے اور ہم پر رحم کر! تو ہی ہمارا مالک ہے، ہمیں کافروں کی قوم پر غلبہ عطا فرما
items.english: Allah does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity. It will have [the consequence of] what [good] it has gained, and it will bear [the consequence of] what [evil] it has earned. "Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people"
items.meaning:
Allah tells us that He does not charge a soul except with what is within its capacity.

Each person will have the consequence of what good they earn and what they do of harm—and the believers pray for ease, forgiveness, and help against the disbelieving people.

You are not asked to carry what Allah knows you cannot bear.
items.reflection:
The burden on you was measured by the One who made you.

Ask Him for ease, pardon, and help—He knows your limits.

items.title: Quran 94:1-4
items.arabic: أَلَمۡ نَشۡرَحۡ لَكَ صَدۡرَكَ ﴿١﴾ وَوَضَعۡنَا عَنكَ وِزۡرَكَ ﴿٢﴾ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهۡرَكَ ﴿٣﴾ وَرَفَعۡنَا لَكَ ذِكۡرَكَ ﴿٤﴾
items.urdu: (1) کیا ہم نے تیرا سینہ نہیں کھول دیا (2) اور تجھ پر سے تیرا بوجھ ہم نے اتار دیا (3) جس نے تیری پیٹھ توڑ دی تھی (4) اور ہمنے تیرا ذکر بلند کر دیا
items.english: (1) Did We not expand for you, [O Muhammad], your breast (2) And We removed from you your burden (3) Which had weighed upon your back (4) And raised high for you your repute
items.meaning:
Allah reminds the Prophet ﷺ: did We not expand your chest, lift from you the burden that weighed down your back, and raise your name high?

The burden that felt crushing was lifted by Allah.
items.reflection:
The weight you carry is seen by the One who lifts burdens.

Ask Him to open your chest as He did for His Prophet.

items.title: Sahih al-Bukhari 39
items.arabic: إِنَّ الدِّينَ يُسْرٌ، وَلَنْ يُشَادَّ الدِّينَ أَحَدٌ إِلاَّ غَلَبَهُ، فَسَدِّدُوا وَقَارِبُوا وَأَبْشِرُوا، وَاسْتَعِينُوا بِالْغَدْوَةِ وَالرَّوْحَةِ وَشَىْءٍ مِنَ الدُّلْجَةِ
items.urdu: بیشک دین آسان ہے اور جو شخص دین میں سختی اختیار کرے گا تو دین اس پر غالب آ جائے گا ( اور اس کی سختی نہ چل سکے گی ) پس ( اس لیے ) اپنے عمل میں پختگی اختیار کرو۔ اور جہاں تک ممکن ہو میانہ روی برتو اور خوش ہو جاؤ ( کہ اس طرز عمل سے تم کو دارین کے فوائد حاصل ہوں گے ) اور صبح اور دوپہر اور شام اور کسی قدر رات میں ( عبادت سے ) مدد حاصل کرو
items.english: Religion is very easy and whoever overburdens himself in his religion will not be able to continue in that way. So you should not be extremists, but try to be near to perfection and receive the good tidings that you will be rewarded; and gain strength by worshipping in the mornings, the afternoons, and during the last hours of the nights
items.meaning:
The religion is easy, and whoever overburdens himself will be overwhelmed. So aim for what is right, come as close as you can, be glad, and draw strength from worship at the ends of the day.

The Prophet ﷺ warns against pushing past your capacity.
items.reflection:
Rest is not failure.

Do what you can, consistently, and be glad.

items.title: Sahih al-Bukhari 6465
items.arabic: سُئِلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَىُّ الأَعْمَالِ أَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ قَالَ أَدْوَمُهَا وَإِنْ قَلَّ . وَقَالَ اكْلَفُوا مِنَ الأَعْمَالِ مَا تُطِيقُونَ
items.urdu: کون سا عمل اللہ کے نزدیک زیادہ پسندیدہ ہے؟ فرمایا کہ جس پر ہمیشگی کی جائے، خواہ وہ تھوڑی ہی ہو اور فرمایا نیک کام کرنے میں اتنی ہی تکلیف اٹھاؤ جتنی طاقت ہے
items.english: What deeds are loved most by Allah?" He said, "The most regular constant deeds even though they may be few." He added, 'Don't take upon yourselves, except the deeds which are within your ability"
items.meaning:
The deeds most loved by Allah are those done consistently, even if small — and the Prophet ﷺ said to take on only what you can bear.

Small and steady beats big and burnt out.
items.reflection:
Shrink the task until you can keep doing it.

Small and steady is beloved to Allah.

items.title: Quran 3:139-140
items.arabic: وَلَا تَهِنُواْ وَلَا تَحۡزَنُواْ وَأَنتُمُ ٱلۡأَعۡلَوۡنَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ ﴿١٣٩﴾ إِن يَمۡسَسۡكُمۡ قَرۡحࣱ فَقَدۡ مَسَّ ٱلۡقَوۡمَ قَرۡحࣱ مِّثۡلُهُۥۚ وَتِلۡكَ ٱلۡأَيَّامُ نُدَاوِلُهَا بَيۡنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَلِيَعۡلَمَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَيَتَّخِذَ مِنكُمۡ شُهَدَآءَۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ ﴿١٤٠﴾
items.urdu: (139) تم نہ سستی کرو اور غمگین ہو، تم ہی غالب رہو گے، اگر تم ایماندار ہو (140) اگر تم زخمی ہوئے ہو تو تمہارے مخالف لوگ بھی تو ایسے ہی زخمی ہو چکے ہیں، ہم ان دنوں کو لوگوں کے درمیان ادلتے بدلتے رہتے ہیں۔ (شکست احد) اس لئے تھی کہ اللہ تعالیٰ ایمان والوں کو ﻇاہر کردے اور تم میں سے بعض کو شہادت کا درجہ عطا فرمائے، اللہ تعالیٰ ﻇالموں سے محبت نہیں کرتا
items.english: (139) So do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are [true] believers (140) If a wound should touch you - there has already touched the [opposing] people a wound similar to it. And these days [of varying conditions] We alternate among the people so that Allah may make evident those who believe and [may] take to Himself from among you martyrs - and Allah does not like the wrongdoers
items.meaning:
After the setback at Uhud, Allah told the believers: do not weaken and do not grieve — you will be uppermost if you are believers. If a wound has touched you, a similar wound touched the other side, and these days are rotated among people.

A defeat is a day, not a destiny.
items.reflection:
This day will turn.

Hold on to your faith; Allah alternates the days.

items.title: Quran 3:146
items.arabic: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن نَّبِيࣲّ قَٰتَلَ مَعَهُۥ رِبِّيُّونَ كَثِيرࣱ فَمَا وَهَنُواْ لِمَآ أَصَابَهُمۡ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا ضَعُفُواْ وَمَا ٱسۡتَكَانُواْۗ وَٱللَّهُ يُحِبُّ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
items.urdu: بہت سے نبیوں کے ہم رکاب ہو کر، بہت سے اللہ والے جہاد کر چکے ہیں، انہیں بھی اللہ کی راه میں تکلیفیں پہنچیں لیکن نہ تو انہوں نے ہمت ہاری نہ سست رہے اور نہ دبے، اور اللہ صبر کرنے والوں کو (ہی) چاہتا ہے
items.english: And how many a prophet [fought and] with him fought many religious scholars. But they never lost assurance due to what afflicted them in the cause of Allah, nor did they weaken or submit. And Allah loves the steadfast
items.meaning:
Allah tells us of prophets and devoted companions who never lost assurance due to what afflicted them in Allah’s way; they did not weaken or humiliate themselves—and Allah loves the patient.

Steadfastness under wound and loss is beloved to Allah.

Faith can remain upright when circumstances bow the body.
items.reflection:
Do not let affliction steal your assurance in Allah.

Patience under pain is something He loves.

items.title: Quran 47:7
items.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِن تَنصُرُواْ ٱللَّهَ يَنصُرۡكُمۡ وَيُثَبِّتۡ أَقۡدَامَكُمۡ
items.urdu: اے ایمان والو! اگر تم اللہ (کے دین) کی مدد کرو گے تو وه تمہاری مدد کرے گا اور تمہیں ﺛابت قدم رکھے گا
items.english: O you who have believed, if you support Allah, He will support you and plant firmly your feet
items.meaning:
Allah tells us that the believers that if they support Allah, He will support them and plant firmly their feet.

Supporting Allah means upholding His religion, truth, and commands. In return comes His aid and stability.

Firm footing is a gift that follows sincere support of His cause.
items.reflection:
Stand for what Allah loves, and He will steady your steps.

His support meets those who support His way.

items.title: Sahih Muslim 2664
items.arabic: الْمُؤْمِنُ الْقَوِيُّ خَيْرٌ وَأَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِ الضَّعِيفِ وَفِي كُلٍّ خَيْرٌاحْرِصْ عَلَى مَا يَنْفَعُكَ وَاسْتَعِنْ بِاللَّهِ وَلاَ تَعْجِزْ وَإِنْ أَصَابَكَ شَىْءٌ فَلاَ تَقُلْ لَوْ أَنِّي فَعَلْتُ كَانَ كَذَا وَكَذَا ‏.‏ وَلَكِنْ قُلْ قَدَرُ اللَّهِ وَمَا شَاءَ فَعَلَ فَإِنَّ لَوْ تَفْتَحُ عَمَلَ الشَّيْطَانِ
items.urdu: طاقت ور مومن اللہ کے نزدیک کمزور مومن کی نسبت بہتر اور زیادہ محبوب ہے ، جبکہ خیر دونوں میں ( موجود ) ہے ۔ جس چیز سے تمہیں ( حقیقی ) نفع پہنچے اس میں حرص کرو اور اللہ سے مدد مانگو اور کمزور نہ پڑو ( مایوس ہو کر نہ بیٹھ ) جاؤ ، اگر تمہیں کوئی ( نقصان ) پہنچے تو یہ نہ کہو : کاش! میں ( اس طرح ) کرتا تو ایسا ایسا ہوتا ، بلکہ یہ کہو : ( یہ ) اللہ کی تقدیر ہے ، وہ جو چاہتا ہے کرتا ہے ، اس لیے کہ ( حشرت کرتے ہوئے ) کاش ( کہنا ) شیطان کے عمل ( کے دروازے ) کو کھول دیتا ہے
items.english: A strong believer is better and is more lovable to Allah than a weak believer, and there is good in everyone, (but) cherish that which gives you benefit (in the Hereafter) and seek help from Allah and do not lose heart, and if anything (in the form of trouble) comes to you, don't say: If I had not done that, it would not have happened so and so, but say: Allah did that what He had ordained to do and your" if" opens the (gate) for the Satan
items.meaning:
The strong believer is more beloved to Allah, and there is good in both. Strive for what benefits you, seek Allah's help, and do not give up. If something befalls you, don't say 'if only'; say 'Allah decreed, and He does what He wills'.

A full plan for getting up after a setback.
items.reflection:
Don't replay the loss. Say: Qaddarallahu wa ma sha'a fa'al.

Then get up and try again with His help.

items.title: Quran 27:62
items.arabic: أَمَّن يُجِيبُ ٱلۡمُضۡطَرَّ إِذَا دَعَاهُ وَيَكۡشِفُ ٱلسُّوٓءَ وَيَجۡعَلُكُمۡ خُلَفَآءَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ أَءِلَٰهࣱ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِۚ قَلِيلࣰا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
items.urdu: بے کس کی پکار کو جب کہ وه پکارے، کون قبول کرکے سختی کو دور کر دیتا ہے؟ اور تمہیں زمین کا خلیفہ بناتا ہے، کیا اللہ تعالیٰ کے ساتھ اور معبود ہے؟ تم بہت کم نصیحت وعبرت حاصل کرتے ہو
items.english: Is He [not best] who responds to the desperate one when he calls upon Him and removes evil and makes you inheritors of the earth? Is there a deity with Allah? Little do you remember
items.meaning:
Allah asks: who answers the desperate one when he calls, and removes the harm? Is there any god besides Allah?

The moment of desperation is exactly when He answers.
items.reflection:
When you have nowhere else to turn, you are in the place where He answers.

Call Him now.

items.title: Quran 21:87-88
items.arabic: وَذَا ٱلنُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَٰضِبࣰا فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقۡدِرَ عَلَيۡهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِي ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ أَن لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبۡحَٰنَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ ﴿٨٧﴾ فَٱسۡتَجَبۡنَا لَهُۥ وَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلۡغَمِّۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُـۨجِي ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ ﴿٨٨﴾
items.urdu: (87) مچھلی والے (حضرت یونس علیہ السلام) کو یاد کرو! جبکہ وه غصہ سے چل دیا اور خیال کیا کہ ہم اسے نہ پکڑ سکیں گے۔ بالﺂخر وه اندھیروں کے اندر سے پکار اٹھا کہ الٰہی تیرے سوا کوئی معبود نہیں تو پاک ہے، بیشک میں ﻇالموں میں ہو گیا (88) تو ہم نے اس کی پکار سن لی اور اسے غم سے نجات دے دی اور ہم ایمان والوں کو اسی طرح بچا لیا کرتے ہیں
items.english: (87) And [mention] the man of the fish, when he went off in anger and thought that We would not decree [anything] upon him. And he called out within the darknesses, "There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers (88) So We responded to him and saved him from the distress. And thus do We save the believers"
items.meaning:
Yunus (as) called out from layers of darkness — inside the whale, in the sea, at night: There is no god but You; glory be to You; I was among the wrongdoers. Allah answered him and rescued him from distress, and says: this is how We rescue the believers.

The rescue is promised to every believer who calls like this.
items.reflection:
Whatever is pulling you under, call out as Yunus did.

La ilaha illa anta, subhanaka, inni kuntu minaz-zalimin.

items.title: Quran 2:214
items.arabic: أَمۡ حَسِبۡتُمۡ أَن تَدۡخُلُواْ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ وَلَمَّا يَأۡتِكُم مَّثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ خَلَوۡاْ مِن قَبۡلِكُمۖ مَّسَّتۡهُمُ ٱلۡبَأۡسَآءُ وَٱلضَّرَّآءُ وَزُلۡزِلُواْ حَتَّىٰ يَقُولَ ٱلرَّسُولُ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مَعَهُۥ مَتَىٰ نَصۡرُ ٱللَّهِۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ نَصۡرَ ٱللَّهِ قَرِيبࣱ‏
items.urdu: کیا تم یہ گمان کئے بیٹھے ہو کہ جنت میں چلے جاؤ گے، حاﻻنکہ اب تک تم پر وه حاﻻت نہیں آئے جو تم سے اگلے لوگوں پر آئے تھے۔ انہیں بیماریاں اور مصیبتیں پہنچیں اور وہ یہاں تک جھنجھوڑے گئے کہ رسول اور اس کے ساتھ کے ایمان والے کہنے لگے کہ اللہ کی مدد کب آئے گی؟ سن رکھو کہ اللہ کی مدد قریب ہی ہے
items.english: Or do you think that you will enter Paradise while such [trial] has not yet come to you as came to those who passed on before you? They were touched by poverty and hardship and were shaken until [even their] messenger and those who believed with him said, "When is the help of Allah?" Unquestionably, the help of Allah is near
items.meaning:
Allah reminds us that those before us were shaken by poverty and hardship until even the messenger and the believers asked: when is Allah's help? And the answer came: indeed, Allah's help is near.

Feeling overwhelmed is part of the path of the best of people.
items.reflection:
If you are asking 'when?', you are in good company.

His help is near.

items.title: Jami' at-Tirmidhi 3524
items.arabic: يَا حَىُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ
items.urdu: اے زندہ اور ہمیشہ رہنے والے! تیری رحمت کے وسیلے سے تیری مدد چاہتا ہوں
items.english: O Living, O Self-Sustaining Sustainer! In Your Mercy do I seek relief (Yā Ḥayyu yā Qayyūm, bi-raḥmatika astaghīth)
items.meaning:
This is what the Prophet ﷺ himself said when something weighed heavily on him.

He called on Allah by two names: al-Hayy (the Ever-Living, who never tires) and al-Qayyum (who holds everything up), and asked for rescue through His mercy.
items.reflection:
When it feels like you're going under, say it: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyum, bi rahmatika astaghith.

The One who holds up the heavens can hold you up too.

items.title: Quran 3:160
items.arabic: إِن يَنصُرۡكُمُ ٱللَّهُ فَلَا غَالِبَ لَكُمۡۖ وَإِن يَخۡذُلۡكُمۡ فَمَن ذَا ٱلَّذِي يَنصُرُكُم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦۗ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلۡيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ
items.urdu: اگر اللہ تعالیٰ تمہاری مدد کرے تو تم پر کوئی غالب نہیں آسکتا اور اگر وہ تمہیں چھوڑ دے تو اس کے بعد کون ہے جو تمہاری مدد کرے؟ ایمان والوں کو اللہ تعالیٰ ہی پر بھروسہ رکھنا چاہئے
items.english: If Allah should aid you, no one can overcome you; but if He should forsake you, who is there that can aid you after Him? And upon Allah let the believers rely
items.meaning:
Allah tells us that if He aids you, no one can overcome you; and if He forsakes you, who can help you after Him? So upon Allah let the believers rely.

Victory and protection are ultimately from Him alone.

Tawakkul is the believer’s response to that truth.
items.reflection:
Seek Allah’s help above every other alliance.

If He is with you, none can truly defeat you.

items.title: Quran 4:28
items.arabic: يُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ أَن يُخَفِّفَ عَنكُمۡۚ وَخُلِقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ ضَعِيفࣰا
items.urdu: اللہ چاہتا ہے کہ تم سے تخفیف کر دے کیونکہ انسان کمزور پیدا کیا گیا ہے
items.english: And Allah wants to lighten for you [your difficulties]; and mankind was created weak
items.meaning:
Allah tells us that He wants to lighten difficulties for us—and that mankind was created weak.

His laws and mercy account for our frailty. He does not delight in crushing us; He wants ease.

Weakness is not a surprise to our Creator.
items.reflection:
Allah wants to lighten your load—He knows you were created weak.

Seek His ease with honesty about your limits.

items.title: Sahih al-Bukhari 6384
items.arabic: يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ قَيْسٍ قُلْ لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ فَإِنَّهَا. كَنْزٌ مِنْ كُنُوزِ الْجَنَّةِ
items.urdu: عبداللہ بن قیس کہو «لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله» کیونکہ یہ جنت کے خزانوں میں سے ایک خزانہ ہے
items.english: O `Abdullah bin Qais! Say: La haul a walaquwata illa bil-lah, for it is one of the treasures of Paradise
items.meaning:
The Prophet ﷺ heard Abu Musa quietly saying La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah and told him: say it, for it is one of the treasures of Paradise.
