The Quran is not only information; it is medicine for anxious, wounded, and restless hearts.

Those who receive it with faith find both direction and comfort.
items.reflection:
When your chest feels tight, turn to the words Allah sent as healing.

Guidance and mercy are waiting in what He revealed.

items.title: Quran 17:82
items.arabic: وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ مَا هُوَ شِفَآءࣱ وَرَحۡمَةࣱ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَلَا يَزِيدُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا خَسَارࣰا
items.urdu: یہ قرآن جو ہم نازل کر رہے ہیں مومنوں کے لئے تو سراسر شفا اور رحمت ہے۔ ہاں ﻇالموں کو بجز نقصان کے اور کوئی زیادتی نہیں ہوتی
items.english: And We send down of the Qur'an that which is healing and mercy for the believers, but it does not increase the wrongdoers except in loss
items.meaning:
Allah tells us that He sends down of the Quran that which is healing and mercy for the believers.

For hearts that receive it with faith, revelation mends and softens. It is a mercy that meets wounds words alone cannot reach.

Approach the Quran as medicine, not only as text.
items.reflection:
Seek healing in what Allah revealed.

For the believing heart, the Quran is mercy that repairs.

items.title: Jami' at-Tirmidhi 3489
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى
items.urdu: اے اللہ! میں تجھ سے ہدایت کا طالب ہوں، تقویٰ کا طلب گار ہوں، پاکدامنی کا خواہشمند ہوں، مالداری اور بے نیازی چاہتا ہوں
items.english: O Allah, indeed, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity, and sufficiency (Allāhumma innī as’alukal-hudā wat-tuqā, wal-`afāfa wal-ghinā).
items.meaning:
The Prophet ﷺ used to ask Allah for guidance, piety, chastity, and sufficiency.

These four—huda, tuqa, ‘afaf, and ghina—cover direction, God-consciousness, purity, and contentment of need.

A compact dua that shapes a whole life of goodness.
items.reflection:
Ask Allah for guidance, piety, chastity, and sufficiency.

These gifts steady both the soul and the path.

items.title: Quran 2:260
items.arabic: وَإِذۡ قَالَ إِبۡرَٰهِـۧمُ رَبِّ أَرِنِي كَيۡفَ تُحۡيِ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰۖ قَالَ أَوَلَمۡ تُؤۡمِنۖ قَالَ بَلَىٰ وَلَٰكِن لِّيَطۡمَئِنَّ قَلۡبِيۖ قَالَ فَخُذۡ أَرۡبَعَةࣰ مِّنَ ٱلطَّيۡرِ فَصُرۡهُنَّ إِلَيۡكَ ثُمَّ ٱجۡعَلۡ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ جَبَلࣲ مِّنۡهُنَّ جُزۡءࣰا ثُمَّ ٱدۡعُهُنَّ يَأۡتِينَكَ سَعۡيࣰاۚ وَٱعۡلَمۡ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمࣱ‏
items.urdu: اور جب ابراہیم (علیہ السلام) نے کہا کہ اے میرے پروردگار! مجھے دکھا تو مُردوں کو کس طرح زنده کرے گا؟ (جناب باری تعالیٰ نے) فرمایا، کیا تمہیں ایمان نہیں؟ جواب دیا ایمان تو ہے لیکن میرے دل کی تسکین ہو جائے گی، فرمایا چار پرند لو، ان کے ٹکڑے کر ڈالو، پھر ہر پہاڑ پر ان کا ایک ایک ٹکڑا رکھ دو پھر انہیں پکارو، تمہارے پاس دوڑتے ہوئے آجائیں گے اور جان رکھو کہ اللہ تعالیٰ غالب ہے حکمتوں واﻻ ہے
items.english: And [mention] when Abraham said, "My Lord, show me how You give life to the dead." [Allah] said, "Have you not believed?" He said, "Yes, but [I ask] only that my heart may be satisfied." [Allah] said, "Take four birds and commit them to yourself. Then [after slaughtering them] put on each hill a portion of them; then call them - they will come [flying] to you in haste. And know that Allah is Exalted in Might and Wise"
items.meaning:
Ibrahim (as) asked Allah to show him how He gives life to the dead. Allah asked: do you not believe? He said: yes, but so that my heart may be at rest. Allah answered him with a sign.

Seeking reassurance is not the same as disbelief.
items.reflection:
It's okay to ask Allah to settle your heart.

A prophet asked the same, and Allah answered him gently.

items.title: Sahih Muslim 132a
items.arabic: إِنَّا نَجِدُ فِي أَنْفُسِنَا مَا يَتَعَاظَمُ أَحَدُنَا أَنْ يَتَكَلَّمَ بِهِ . قَالَ وَقَدْ وَجَدْتُمُوهُ . قَالُوا نَعَمْ . قَالَ ذَاكَ صَرِيحُ الإِيمَانِ
items.urdu: ہم اپنے دلوں میں ایسی چیزیں محسوس کرتے ہیں کہ ہم میں سے کوئی ان کو زبان پر لانا بہت سنگین سمجھتا ہے ، آپ نے پوچھا : ’’ کیا تم نے واقعی اپنے دلوں میں ایسا محسوس کیا ہے ؟ ‘ ‘ انہوں نے عرض کی : جی ہاں ۔ آپ نے فرمایا : ’’ یہی صریح ایمان ہے
items.english: Verily we perceive in our minds that which every one of us considers it too grave to express. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Do you really perceive it? They said: Yes. Upon this he remarked: That is the faith manifest
items.meaning:
Companions told the Prophet ﷺ they found thoughts in themselves too terrible to speak. He asked if they really felt that, and said: that is clear faith.

Hating those whispers is itself a sign of living faith.
items.reflection:
You are not a bad Muslim for having intrusive thoughts.

The fact that they bother you shows your faith is alive.

items.title: Sahih al-Bukhari 3276
items.arabic: يَأْتِي الشَّيْطَانُ أَحَدَكُمْ فَيَقُولُ مَنْ خَلَقَ كَذَا مَنْ خَلَقَ كَذَا حَتَّى يَقُولَ مَنْ خَلَقَ رَبَّكَ فَإِذَا بَلَغَهُ فَلْيَسْتَعِذْ بِاللَّهِ، وَلْيَنْتَهِ
items.urdu: تم میں سے کسی کے پاس شیطان آتا ہے اور تمہارے دل میں پہلے تو یہ سوال پیدا کرتا ہے کہ فلاں چیز کس نے پیدا کی، فلاں چیز کس نے پیدا کی؟ اور آخر میں بات یہاں تک پہنچاتا ہے کہ خود تمہارے رب کو کس نے پیدا کیا؟ جب کسی شخص کو ایسا وسوسہ ڈالے تو اللہ سے پناہ مانگنی چاہئے، شیطانی خیال کو چھوڑ دے
items.english: Satan comes to one of you and says, 'Who created so-and-so? 'till he says, 'Who has created your Lord?' So, when he inspires such a question, one should seek refuge with Allah and give up such thoughts.
items.meaning:
Shaytan comes and asks 'who created this, who created that' until he asks 'who created your Lord?' When it reaches that point, seek refuge in Allah and stop.

Not every whisper deserves a conversation.
items.reflection:
When the loop starts, say A'udhu billah and step away.

You are allowed to not follow every thought.

items.title: Quran 93:6-8
items.arabic: أَلَمۡ يَجِدۡكَ يَتِيمࣰا فَـَٔاوَىٰ ﴿٦﴾ وَوَجَدَكَ ضَآلࣰّا فَهَدَىٰ ﴿٧﴾ وَوَجَدَكَ عَآئِلࣰا فَأَغۡنَىٰ ﴿٨﴾
items.urdu: (6) کیا اس نے تجھے یتیم پا کر جگہ نہیں دی (7) اور تجھے راه بھوﻻ پا کر ہدایت نہیں دی (8) اور تجھے نادار پاکر تونگر نہیں بنا دیا؟
items.english: (6) Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge (7) And He found you lost and guided [you] (8) And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient
items.meaning:
Allah reminds the Prophet ﷺ: did He not find you an orphan and give you shelter, find you lost and guide you, find you in need and make you self-sufficient?

Guidance is something Allah gives to those who feel lost.
items.reflection:
Feeling lost is not the end of the story.

Ask Him to find you and guide you, as He did before.

items.title: Quran 29:69
items.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ جَٰهَدُواْ فِينَا لَنَهۡدِيَنَّهُمۡ سُبُلَنَاۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَمَعَ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
items.urdu: اور جو لوگ ہماری راه میں مشقتیں برداشت کرتے ہیں ہم انہیں اپنی راہیں ضرور دکھا دیں گے۔ یقیناً اللہ تعالیٰ نیکو کاروں کا ساتھی ہے
items.english: And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways. And indeed, Allah is with the doers of good
items.meaning:
Allah promises those who strive for Him: We will surely guide them to Our paths, and Allah is with those who do good.

The path opens to the one who keeps moving toward Him.
items.reflection:
You don't need the whole map — just keep striving for Him.

He has promised to show you the way.

items.title: Sahih Muslim 2577a
items.arabic: يَا عِبَادِي كُلُّكُمْ ضَالٌّ إِلاَّ مَنْ هَدَيْتُهُ فَاسْتَهْدُونِي أَهْدِكُمْ
items.urdu: میرے بندو! تم سب کے سب گمراہ ہو ، سوائے اس کے جسے میں ہدایت دے دوں ، اس لیے مجھ سے ہدایت مانگو ، میں تمہیں ہدایت دوں گا
items.english: O My servants, all of you are astray except for those I have guided, so seek guidance of Me and I shall guide you
items.meaning:
In this hadith qudsi Allah says: O My servants, all of you are astray except whom I guide — so ask Me for guidance and I will guide you.

Feeling lost is the human condition; guidance is a gift you simply have to ask for.
items.reflection:
You don't have to find the way alone.

Ask Him directly: O Allah, guide me.
